verses.sloka: ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः ।इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि ॥५-१-१॥
verses.transliteration: tato rāvaṇanītāyāḥ sītāyāḥ śatrukarśanaḥ ।iyeṣa padamanveṣṭuṁ cāraṇācarite pathi ॥5-1-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, crusher of enemies resolved to find the whereabouts of Sita, carried away by Ravana. He followed the path of the Charanas, celestial bards.

verses.sloka: दुष्करं निष्प्रतिद्वन्द्वं चिकीर्षन् कर्म वानरः ।समुदग्रशिरोग्रीवो गवांपतिरिवाबभौ ॥५-१-२॥
verses.transliteration: duṣkaraṁ niṣpratidvandvaṁ cikīrṣan karma vānaraḥ ।samudagraśirogrīvo gavāṁpatirivābabhau ॥5-1-2॥

translations.english: Hanuman who raised his head and neck, intending to cross the formidable ocean which none else could accomplish, looked like a leading bull.

verses.sloka: अथ वैडूर्यवर्णेषु शाद्वलेषु महाबलः ।धीरः सलिलकल्पेषु विच्चार यथासुखम् ॥५-१-३॥
verses.transliteration: atha vaiḍūryavarṇeṣu śādvaleṣu mahābalaḥ ।dhīraḥ salilakalpeṣu viccāra yathāsukham ॥5-1-3॥

translations.english: Tawnyhued Hanuman, gifted with extraordinary strength and patience happily strolled on the marshy tracts of grassy land which had the colour of vaidurya.

verses.sloka: द्विजान् वित्रासयन् धीमानुरसा पादपान् हरन् ।मृगांश्च सुबाहुन्निघ्नन् प्रवृद्ध इव केसरी॥५-१-४॥
verses.transliteration: dvijān vitrāsayan dhīmānurasā pādapān haran ।mṛgāṁśca subāhunnighnan pravṛddha iva kesarī॥5-1-4॥

translations.english: Wise Hanuman went about like a lion scaring away birds, uprooting trees with his chest, and trampling many animals.

verses.sloka: नीललोहितमाञ्जिष्ठपत्रवर्णैः सितासितैः ।स्वभावविहितैश्चित्रैर्धातुभिः समलंकृतम् ॥५-१-५॥
verses.transliteration: nīlalohitamāñjiṣṭhapatravarṇaiḥ sitāsitaiḥ ।svabhāvavihitaiścitrairdhātubhiḥ samalaṁkṛtam ॥5-1-5॥

translations.english: The mountain was as though decorated with mineral rocks of varied colours like blue, red, yellow and green as well as black and white৷৷It was frequently visited by yakshas, kinneras, gandharvas and nagas surrounded by their retinue, capable of assuming any form at their free will rivalling gods and nagas in splendour.
translations.hindi: ग्रतएव हे पवतोत्तम ! म॑ तुमसे कहता हूँ झि, तुम उठो । देखो ये बलवान हनुमान तुम्हारे ऊपर पहुंचना ही चाहते हैं

verses.sloka: कामरूपिभिराविष्टमभीक्ष्णं सपरिच्छिदैः ।यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वैर्देवक्ल्पैश्च पन्नगैः ॥५-१-६॥
verses.transliteration: kāmarūpibhirāviṣṭamabhīkṣṇaṁ saparicchidaiḥ ।yakṣakinnaragandharvairdevaklpaiśca pannagaiḥ ॥5-1-6॥

translations.english: The mountain was as though decorated with mineral rocks of varied colours like blue, red, yellow and green as well as black and white৷৷It was frequently visited by yakshas, kinneras, gandharvas and nagas surrounded by their retinue, capable of assuming any form at their free will rivalling gods and nagas in splendour.

verses.sloka: स तस्य गिरिवर्यस्य तले नागवरायुते ।तिष्ठन् कपिवरस्तत्र ह्रदे नाग इवाबभौ ॥५-१-७॥
verses.transliteration: sa tasya girivaryasya tale nāgavarāyute ।tiṣṭhan kapivarastatra hrade nāga ivābabhau ॥5-1-7॥

translations.english: As the monkey leader stood at the foot of the great mountain filled with lordly elephants he looked like an elephant standing at the centre of a pond.

verses.sloka: स सूर्याय महेन्द्राय पवनाय स्वयंभुवे ।भूतेभ्यश्चाञ्जलिं कृत्वा चकार गमने मतिम् ॥५-१-८॥
verses.transliteration: sa sūryāya mahendrāya pavanāya svayaṁbhuve ।bhūtebhyaścāñjaliṁ kṛtvā cakāra gamane matim ॥5-1-8॥

translations.english: Offering salutations with folded palms to the Sungod, to Mahendra, lord of the gods, to the windgod, to the Creator Brahma and to all the attendants of lord Siva, made up his mind to proceed (to Lanka).

verses.sloka: अञ्जलिं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा पवनायात्मयोओनयो ।ततो हि ववृधे गन्तुं दक्षिणो दक्षिणां दिश्म् ॥५-१-९॥
verses.transliteration: añjaliṁ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtvā pavanāyātmayoonayo ।tato hi vavṛdhe gantuṁ dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇāṁ diśm ॥5-1-9॥

translations.english: Hanuman, endowed with great equanimity, facing the east and joining his palms by way of salutaion to the Windgod, his father, he enlarged his size and turned south in order to depart.

verses.sloka: प्लवङ्गप्रवरैर्दृष्टः प्लवने कृतनिश्चयः ।ववृधे रामवृद्ध्यर्थम् समुद्र इव पर्वसु ॥५-१-१०॥
verses.transliteration: plavaṅgapravarairdṛṣṭaḥ plavane kṛtaniścayaḥ ।vavṛdhe rāmavṛddhyartham samudra iva parvasu ॥5-1-10॥

translations.english: Having made up his mind to leap for the cause of Rama, Hanuman began to grow in size just as the sea grows during the fullmoon and newmoon days, while the monkey troops were watching.
translations.hindi: वानरश्रेष्ठों ने देखा कि श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के कार्य की सिद्धि के लिए, समुद्र लांघने का निश्चय किए हुए हनुमानजी का शरीर, ऐसे बढ्ने लगा जैसे पूर्णमासी के दिन समुद्र बढ़ता है

verses.sloka: निष्प्रमाणशरीरः सन् लिलङ्घयिषुरर्णवम् ।बाहुभ्यां पीडयामास चरणाभ्यां च पर्वतम् ॥५-१-११॥
verses.transliteration: niṣpramāṇaśarīraḥ san lilaṅghayiṣurarṇavam ।bāhubhyāṁ pīḍayāmāsa caraṇābhyāṁ ca parvatam ॥5-1-11॥

translations.english: Having swollen to an immeasurable figure, he pressed on the mountain with his feet and hands in an attempt to cross the ocean.

verses.sloka: स चचालाचलश्चापि मुहूर्तं कपिपीडितः ।तरूणां पुष्पिताग्राणां सर्वं पुष्पमशातयत् ॥५-१-१२॥
verses.transliteration: sa cacālācalaścāpi muhūrtaṁ kapipīḍitaḥ ।tarūṇāṁ puṣpitāgrāṇāṁ sarvaṁ puṣpamaśātayat ॥5-1-12॥

translations.english: Pressed firmly by Hanuman, the mountain was shaken for a moment which caused the flowers to drop down from the tree tops.
translations.hindi: दबाने से एक मुहूर्त तक वह ग्रचल पर्वत -चलायमान हो . गया श्रौर उसके ऊपर जो पुष्पित वृक्ष थे, उन वृक्षों के सब फल झड़ कर गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: तेन पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पौघेन सुगन्धिना ।सर्वतः संवृतः शैलो बभौ पुष्पमयो यथा ॥५-१-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tena pādapamuktena puṣpaughena sugandhinā ।sarvataḥ saṁvṛtaḥ śailo babhau puṣpamayo yathā ॥5-1-13॥

translations.english: With heaps of flowers full of fragrance fallen down from the trees all over the mountain, it looked as though it was a mountain of flowers.
translations.hindi: वृक्षों से झड़े हुए सुगन्धयुक्त फूलों के ढेरों से वह पर्वत ढक गया आर ऐसा जान पड़ने लगा, मानों वह समस्त पहाड़ फूलों ही का है

verses.sloka: तेन चोत्तमवीर्येण पीड्यमानः स पर्वतः ।सलिलं संप्रसुस्राव मदं मत्त इव द्विपः ॥५-१-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tena cottamavīryeṇa pīḍyamānaḥ sa parvataḥ ।salilaṁ saṁprasusrāva madaṁ matta iva dvipaḥ ॥5-1-14॥

translations.english: The mountain pressed hard under the feet of the valiant (Hanuman), discharged streams of water just as an elephant in rut would exude water of intoxication.

verses.sloka: पीड्यमानस्तु बलिना महेन्द्रस्तेन पर्वतः ।रीतीर्निर्वर्तयामास काञ्चनाञ्जनराजतीः ॥५-१-१५॥
verses.transliteration: pīḍyamānastu balinā mahendrastena parvataḥ ।rītīrnirvartayāmāsa kāñcanāñjanarājatīḥ ॥5-1-15॥

translations.english: Pressed by the powerful Hanuman, mount Mahendra let out streams of the hue of gold and silver (containing the ores of these minerals)৷৷
translations.hindi: बलवान्‌ हनुमानजी के दवाने से उस महेन्द्राचल पर्वत के चारों ओर घातुश्नो के बह निकलने से ऐसा जान पड़ता था, माना पिघलाए हुए सोने और चाँदी की रेखाएं खिची हों

verses.sloka: मुमोच च शिलाः शैलो विशालाः समनःशिलाः ।मध्यमेनार्चिषा जुष्टो धूमराजीरिवानलः ॥५-१-१६॥
verses.transliteration: mumoca ca śilāḥ śailo viśālāḥ samanaḥśilāḥ ।madhyamenārciṣā juṣṭo dhūmarājīrivānalaḥ ॥5-1-16॥

translations.english: The mountain threw down big boulders along with sulphur just like fire emits columns of smoke, surrounded by flames.
translations.hindi: वह पर्वत मनसिलयुक्त बड़ी-बड़ी शिलाएं गिराने लगा उस समय ऐसा जान पड़ा, मानो बीच में तो आग जल रही हो श्रौर चारों शोर घुं निकल रहा हो

verses.sloka: गिरिणा पीड्यमानेन पीड्यमानानि सर्वशः ।गुहाविष्टानि भूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः ॥५-१-१७॥
verses.transliteration: giriṇā pīḍyamānena pīḍyamānāni sarvaśaḥ ।guhāviṣṭāni bhūtāni vinedurvikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ ॥5-1-17॥

translations.english: Squeezed on all sides of the mountain by Hanuman, all creatures living in the caves shrieked making horrible sounds .
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी के द्वारा उस पंत के दबाए जाने पर उस पर्वत की गुफाम्रों में रहने वाले समस्त जीव-जन्तु दव गए और विकराल शब्द करने लगे

verses.sloka: स महासत्त्वसंनादः शैलपीडानिमित्तजः ।पृथिवीं पूरयामास दिशश्चोपवनानि च ॥५-१-१८॥
verses.transliteration: sa mahāsattvasaṁnādaḥ śailapīḍānimittajaḥ ।pṛthivīṁ pūrayāmāsa diśaścopavanāni ca ॥5-1-18॥

translations.english: Due to the crushing of the mountain, a loud noise of the various creatures shot up filling the earth in all directions and groves around.
translations.hindi: पवत के दबने के कारण उन जी4-जस्तुओं ने ऐसा घोर शब्द किया कि, उससे सम्पूणं पृथिवी, दिशा प्रौर जंगल भर गए

verses.sloka: शिरोभिः पृथुभिः सर्पा व्यक्तस्वस्तिकलक्षणैः ।वमन्तः पावकं घोरं ददंशुर्दशनैः शिलाः ॥५-१-१९॥
verses.transliteration: śirobhiḥ pṛthubhiḥ sarpā vyaktasvastikalakṣaṇaiḥ ।vamantaḥ pāvakaṁ ghoraṁ dadaṁśurdaśanaiḥ śilāḥ ॥5-1-19॥

translations.english: The snakes spread out their broad hoods manifesting swastika marks on them and bit the rocks with their fangs pouring out terrible fire.

verses.sloka: तास्तदा सविषैर्दष्टाः कुपितैस्तैर्महाशिलाः।जज्ज्वलुः पावकोद्दीप्ता बिभिदुश्च सहस्रधा ॥५-१-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tāstadā saviṣairdaṣṭāḥ kupitaistairmahāśilāḥ।jajjvaluḥ pāvakoddīptā bibhiduśca sahasradhā ॥5-1-20॥

translations.english: Bitten by the venomous and angry snakes, the mountain was broken into a thousand pieces by the blazing flames.
translations.hindi: क्रुद्ध होकर विषधरों द्वारा दाँतों से काटी गई वे बडी बड़ी दिला जलने लगीं और उनके हजारों टुकड़े हो गए-

verses.sloka: यानि चौषधजालानि तस्मिन् जातानि पर्वते ।विषघ्नान्यपि नागानां न शेकुः शमितुं विषम्॥५-१-२१॥
verses.transliteration: yāni cauṣadhajālāni tasmin jātāni parvate ।viṣaghnānyapi nāgānāṁ na śekuḥ śamituṁ viṣam॥5-1-21॥

translations.english: Even the medicinal herbs grown on the mountain could not neutralize the effect of the poison of snakes.

verses.sloka: भिद्यतेऽयं गिरिर्भूतैरिति मत्त्वा तपस्विनः ।त्रस्ता विद्याधरास्तस्मादुत्पेतुः स्त्रीगणैः सह॥५-१-२२॥
verses.transliteration: bhidyate'yaṁ girirbhūtairiti mattvā tapasvinaḥ ।trastā vidyādharāstasmādutpetuḥ strīgaṇaiḥ saha॥5-1-22॥

translations.english: Even the ascetics left the place approaching that the mountain would be broken into pieces by creatures. The alarmed vidyadharas leaped into the sky along with groups of their women, leaving behind golden jugs of wine as well as precious utensils, big and small sizes, and golden goblets, cups in the drinking place, as well as many tasty eatables like licking food, chewing food and many types of meat. They also left bullhides and swords with golden sheaths.
translations.hindi: जब हनमानजी ने पर्वत को दबाया, तब उस पर्वत पर बसने वाले तपस्वी श्रौर विद्याधर लोग घबड़ा कर ग्रपनी श्रपनी स्त्रियों को साथ ले वहाँ से चल दिए

verses.sloka: पानभूमिगतं हित्वा हैममासवभाजनम् ।पात्रणि च महार्हाणि करकांश्च हिरण्मयान् ॥५-१-२३॥
verses.transliteration: pānabhūmigataṁ hitvā haimamāsavabhājanam ।pātraṇi ca mahārhāṇi karakāṁśca hiraṇmayān ॥5-1-23॥

translations.english: Even the ascetics left the place approaching that the mountain would be broken into pieces by creatures. The alarmed vidyadharas leaped into the sky along with groups of their women, leaving behind golden jugs of wine as well as precious utensils, big and small sizes, and golden goblets, cups in the drinking place, as well as many tasty eatables like licking food, chewing food and many types of meat. They also left bullhides and swords with golden sheaths.
translations.hindi: श्रौर शराब पीने की जगह पर जो सोने की बैठकी श्रौर बड़े | बड़े मूल्यवान सुवर्णपात्र और सुवणं के करवे थे, उन्हें वे वहीं छोड़ कर चल दिए

verses.sloka: लेह्यानुच्चावचान् भक्ष्यान् मांसानि विविधानि च ।आर्षभाणि च चर्माणि खड्गांश्च कनकत्सरून् ॥५-१-२४॥
verses.transliteration: lehyānuccāvacān bhakṣyān māṁsāni vividhāni ca ।ārṣabhāṇi ca carmāṇi khaḍgāṁśca kanakatsarūn ॥5-1-24॥

translations.english: Even the ascetics left the place approaching that the mountain would be broken into pieces by creatures. The alarmed vidyadharas leaped into the sky along with groups of their women, leaving behind golden jugs of wine as well as precious utensils, big and small sizes, and golden goblets, cups in the drinking place, as well as many tasty eatables like licking food, chewing food and many types of meat. They also left bullhides and swords with golden sheaths.

verses.sloka: कृतक्ण्ठगुणाः क्षीबा र्क्तमाल्यानुलेपनाः ।र्क्तक्षाः पुष्कराक्षाश्च गगनं प्रतिपेदिरे ॥५-१-२५॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtakṇṭhaguṇāḥ kṣībā rktamālyānulepanāḥ ।rktakṣāḥ puṣkarākṣāśca gaganaṁ pratipedire ॥5-1-25॥

translations.english: The intoxicated vidyadharas with eyes red like lotuses, wearing garlands around the neck and smeared with red sandalpaste flew into the sky.
translations.hindi: गलों में सुन्दर पुष्पहारों को पहिने तथा शरीरों में अच्छे ग्रंगराग ¢ लगाए अरुण एवं कमल जेसे नेत्रों वाले विद्याधरों ने श्राकाश में जाकर दम ली

verses.sloka: हारनूपुरकेयूरपारिहार्यधराः स्त्रियः ।विस्मिताः सस्मितास्तस्थुराकाशे रमणैः सह ॥५-१-२६॥
verses.transliteration: hāranūpurakeyūrapārihāryadharāḥ striyaḥ ।vismitāḥ sasmitāstasthurākāśe ramaṇaiḥ saha ॥5-1-26॥

translations.english: Adorned with necklaces, anklets and armlets, the vidyadharis stayed wonderstruck in the sky, smiling gently in the company of their lovers.
translations.hindi: इनकी स्त्रियां, जो हार, नूपुर (बिछवा) , विजायठ और ककनों से अपना शरीर सजाए हुए थीं, अत्यन्त आश्चर्यचकित हो अपने अपने पतियों के पास जाकर, आकाश में खड़ी हो गईं

verses.sloka: दर्शयन्तो महाविद्यां विद्याधरमहर्षयः ।सहितास्तस्थुराकाशे वीक्षाञ्चक्रुश्च पर्वतम्॥५-१-२७॥
verses.transliteration: darśayanto mahāvidyāṁ vidyādharamaharṣayaḥ ।sahitāstasthurākāśe vīkṣāñcakruśca parvatam॥5-1-27॥

translations.english: The seers among the Vidyadharas, proficient in different fields of knowledge were also watching the mountain from the sky along with others.

verses.sloka: शुश्रुवुश्चतदा शब्दमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्।चारणानां च सिद्धानां स्थितानांविमलेऽम्बरे॥५-१-२८॥
verses.transliteration: śuśruvuścatadā śabdamṛṣīṇāṁ bhāvitātmanām।cāraṇānāṁ ca siddhānāṁ sthitānāṁvimale'mbare॥5-1-28॥

translations.english: Then the vidyadharas heard the words of praise(of Hanuman) by the sages, seekers of the ultimate truth, the charanas and the siddhas who stood and watched in the clear sky:

verses.sloka: एष पर्वतसंकाशो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ।तितीर्षति महावेगः समुद्रं मकरालयम् ॥५-१-२९॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa parvatasaṁkāśo hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ।titīrṣati mahāvegaḥ samudraṁ makarālayam ॥5-1-29॥

translations.english: "Hanuman the son of the Windgod, who is like a mountain, with extraordinary might intends to cross the ocean, the abode of crocodiles".

verses.sloka: रामार्थं वानरार्थं च चिकीर्षन् कर्मदुष्करम् ।समुद्रस्य परं पारं दुष्प्रापं प्राप्तुमिच्छति॥५-१-३०॥
verses.transliteration: rāmārthaṁ vānarārthaṁ ca cikīrṣan karmaduṣkaram ।samudrasya paraṁ pāraṁ duṣprāpaṁ prāptumicchati॥5-1-30॥

translations.english: "For the sake of Rama and the vanaras he wants to reach the other shore of the ocean, which is difficult, and indeed impossible".
translations.hindi: ये वीर वानर हनुमान जी, श्रीरामचन्द्र का कार्यसिद्ध करने भ्रौर इन वानरों के प्राण बचाने के लिए, दुलंङघ्य समुद्र के उस पार जाने की इच्छा कर, एक दुष्कर कार्यं करना चाहते हैं

verses.sloka: इति विद्याधराः श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां महात्मनाम् ।तमप्रमेयं ददृशुः पर्वते वानरर्षभम् ॥५-१-३१॥
verses.transliteration: iti vidyādharāḥ śrutvā vacasteṣāṁ mahātmanām ।tamaprameyaṁ dadṛśuḥ parvate vānararṣabham ॥5-1-31॥

translations.english: The vidyadharas heard the sages speaking in that manner on the mountain. They beheld Hanuman, the bull among vanaras, whose strength was beyond measure.
translations.hindi: उन तपस्वियों की कही हुई इन बातों को सुन विद्याधर लोग उस पर्वत पर खडे ग्रप्रमेय बलशाली हनुमानजी को देखने लगे

verses.sloka: दुधुवे च स रोमाणि चकम्पे चाचलोपमः ।ननाद सुमहानादं सुमहानिव तोयदः ॥५-१-३२॥
verses.transliteration: dudhuve ca sa romāṇi cakampe cācalopamaḥ ।nanāda sumahānādaṁ sumahāniva toyadaḥ ॥5-1-32॥

translations.english: Hanuman, huge as a mountain moved his body and shook the hair on his body, thundering like a cloud.

verses.sloka: आनुपूर्व्येण वृत्तं च लाङ्गूलं लोमभिश्चितम् ।उत्पतिष्यन् विचिक्षेप पक्षिराज इवोरगम् ॥५-१-३३॥
verses.transliteration: ānupūrvyeṇa vṛttaṁ ca lāṅgūlaṁ lomabhiścitam ।utpatiṣyan vicikṣepa pakṣirāja ivoragam ॥5-1-33॥

translations.english: Like the king of birds Garuda would shake a serpent, he shook his tail covered with hair in order to take off.
translations.hindi: श्रौर चढ़ाव-उतारदार एवं गोल श्रौर रुएंदार श्रपनी पूछ को हनुमानजी ने वैसे ही झटकारा जेसे गरुड़ साँप को झटकारता है

verses.sloka: तस्य लाङ्गूलमाविद्धमात्तवेगस्य पृष्ठतः ।ददृशे गरुडेनेव ह्रियमाणो महोरगः ॥५-१-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tasya lāṅgūlamāviddhamāttavegasya pṛṣṭhataḥ ।dadṛśe garuḍeneva hriyamāṇo mahoragaḥ ॥5-1-34॥

translations.english: Hanuman had the tail curled at his back which appeared like a big serpent being carried off by Garuda.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“महात्मनाम्‌'” । शरण सुन्दरकाण्ड इनकी पीठ पर बड़े बेग से हिलती हुई इनकी पूछ, गरुड़ द्वारा पकड़े हुए भ्रजगर साँप की तरह हिलती हुई, देख पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: बाहू संस्तंभयामास महापरिघसंनिभौ ।ससाद च कपिः क्ट्यां चरणौ संचुकोच च ॥५-१-३५॥
verses.transliteration: bāhū saṁstaṁbhayāmāsa mahāparighasaṁnibhau ।sasāda ca kapiḥ kṭyāṁ caraṇau saṁcukoca ca ॥5-1-35॥

translations.english: The monkey fixed his arms, looking like iron clubs, firmly on the mountain and crouched his waist and contracted his feet.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने (कूदने के समय अपने परिघ जैसे आकार वाली दोनों मुजाम्रों को जमा कर, कमर पर दोनों पैरों का बल दिया और उनको (पैरों को) सिकोड़-लिया

verses.sloka: संहृत्य च भुजौ श्रीमांस्तथैव च शिरोधराम् ।तेजः स्त्त्वं तथा वीर्यमाविवेश स वीर्यवान् ॥५-१-३६॥
verses.transliteration: saṁhṛtya ca bhujau śrīmāṁstathaiva ca śirodharām ।tejaḥ sttvaṁ tathā vīryamāviveśa sa vīryavān ॥5-1-36॥

translations.english: The glorious and courageous Hanuman his head and shoulders contracted, summoned up all his energy and vigour.
translations.hindi: बे कपियों में उत्तम हनुमान बानरों से बोले कि, जिस प्रकार श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के छोड़े हुए बाण हवा की तरह जाते हैं, उसी प्रकार में रावणपालित लंका में चला जाऊंगा | यदि जनकनन्दिनी मुझे वहाँ न देख पड़ी तो इसी वेग से मै स्वर्ग को चला जाऊंगा । यदि वहाँ भी प्रयत्न करने पर सीता न देख पड़ीं, तो में राक्षसराज रावण को बाँध कर यहाँ ले ग्राँगा । या तो मैं इस प्रकार सफलमनोरथ हो सीता सहित ही लोटू'गा नहीं तो रावण सहित लंका को उखाड़ कर ही ले भ्राऊंगा । कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी ने वानरों से इस प्रकार कहा

verses.sloka: मार्गमालोकयन्दूरादूर्ध्वं प्रणिहितेक्षणः ।रुरोध हृदये प्राणानाकाशमवलोकयन् ॥५-१-३७॥
verses.transliteration: mārgamālokayandūrādūrdhvaṁ praṇihitekṣaṇaḥ ।rurodha hṛdaye prāṇānākāśamavalokayan ॥5-1-37॥

translations.english: Having cast his eyes upward in order to view the distance and direction in which he had to leap, he restrained his breath in the chest while looking at the sky.

verses.sloka: पद्भ्यां दृढमवस्थानं कृत्वा स कपिकुञ्जरः ।निकुञ्च्य कर्णौ हनुमानुत्पतिष्यन् महाबलः ।वानरान् वानरश्रेष्ठ इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-१-३८॥
verses.transliteration: padbhyāṁ dṛḍhamavasthānaṁ kṛtvā sa kapikuñjaraḥ ।nikuñcya karṇau hanumānutpatiṣyan mahābalaḥ ।vānarān vānaraśreṣṭha idaṁ vacanamabravīt ॥5-1-38॥

translations.english: A mighty elephant among vanaras, Hanuman holding his feet firmly and standing in that position, contracted his ears and addressed the monkeys, when he was about to leap:

verses.sloka: यथा राघवनिर्मुक्तः शरः श्वसनविक्रमः ।गच्चेत्तद्वद्गमिष्यामि लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् ॥५-१-३९॥
verses.transliteration: yathā rāghavanirmuktaḥ śaraḥ śvasanavikramaḥ ।gaccettadvadgamiṣyāmi laṅkāṁ rāvaṇapālitām ॥5-1-39॥

translations.english: "Just like an arrow released by Raghava would fly, I too will proceed with the speed of the wind to reach Lanka ruled by Ravana.

verses.sloka: न हि द्रक्ष्यामि यदि तां लङ्कायां जनकात्मजाम् ।अनेनैव हि वेगेन गमिष्यामि सुरालयम् ॥५-१-४०॥
verses.transliteration: na hi drakṣyāmi yadi tāṁ laṅkāyāṁ janakātmajām ।anenaiva hi vegena gamiṣyāmi surālayam ॥5-1-40॥

translations.english: "If I am not able to find the daughter of Janaka at Lanka I will go to heaven, abode of the gods, with the same speed.

verses.sloka: यदि वा त्रिदिवे सीतां न द्रक्ष्याम्यकृतश्रमः ।बद्ध्वा राक्षसराजानमानयिष्यामि रावणम् ॥५-१-४१॥
verses.transliteration: yadi vā tridive sītāṁ na drakṣyāmyakṛtaśramaḥ ।baddhvā rākṣasarājānamānayiṣyāmi rāvaṇam ॥5-1-41॥

translations.english: "If I do not find Sita in heaven in spite of my efforts, I will bind that king of demons, Ravana and bring him here.

verses.sloka: सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽहमेष्यामि सह सीतया ।आनयिष्यामि वा लङ्कां समुत्पाट्य सरावणाम् ॥५-१-४२॥
verses.transliteration: sarvathā kṛtakāryo'hameṣyāmi saha sītayā ।ānayiṣyāmi vā laṅkāṁ samutpāṭya sarāvaṇām ॥5-1-42॥

translations.english: "I will, by all means return successful with Sita or else I will uproot Lanka along with Ravana and bring him here".

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु हनुमान्वानरान्वानरोत्तमः ॥५-१-४३॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu hanumānvānarānvānarottamaḥ ॥5-1-43॥

translations.english: Having thus addressed the monkeys the foremost of vanaras,Hanuman endowed with great speed leaped without any exertion. The elephant among monkeys felt like Garuda.

verses.sloka: उत्पपाताथ वेगेन वेगवानविचारयन् ।सुपर्णमिव चात्मानं मेने स कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-१-४४॥
verses.transliteration: utpapātātha vegena vegavānavicārayan ।suparṇamiva cātmānaṁ mene sa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥5-1-44॥

translations.english: Having thus addressed the monkeys the foremost of vanaras,Hanuman endowed with great speed leaped without any exertion. The elephant among monkeys felt like Garuda.

verses.sloka: समुत्पतति तस्मिंस्तु वेगात्ते नगरोहिणः ।संहृत्य विटपान् सर्वान् समुत्पेतुः समन्ततः ॥५-१-४५॥
verses.transliteration: samutpatati tasmiṁstu vegātte nagarohiṇaḥ ।saṁhṛtya viṭapān sarvān samutpetuḥ samantataḥ ॥5-1-45॥

translations.english: When he took off, numerous trees on the mountain drawing together the branches all over flew along with him.

verses.sloka: स मत्तकोयष्टिभकान् पादपान् पुष्पशालिनः ।उद्वहन्नूरुवेगेन जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे ॥५-१-४६॥
verses.transliteration: sa mattakoyaṣṭibhakān pādapān puṣpaśālinaḥ ।udvahannūruvegena jagāma vimale'mbare ॥5-1-46॥

translations.english: He swept away the lapwings in heat on the blossoms of the trees by the speed of his thighs while he coursed through the cloudless sky.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी पक्षियों से युक्त और पुष्पित वृक्षों को अपनी जाँघो के वेग से भ्रपने साथ लिए हुए विमल भ्राकाझ में गये

verses.sloka: ऊरुवेगोत्थिता वृक्षा मुहूर्तं कपिमन्वयुः ।प्रस्थितं दीर्घमध्वानं स्वबन्धमिव बान्धवाः ॥५-१-४७॥
verses.transliteration: ūruvegotthitā vṛkṣā muhūrtaṁ kapimanvayuḥ ।prasthitaṁ dīrghamadhvānaṁ svabandhamiva bāndhavāḥ ॥5-1-47॥

translations.english: Swept away by the force of his thighs, the trees bent forward following him for a while just as relatives accompany their kith and kin on long travel.
translations.hindi: जांघों के वेग से उड़े हुए पेड़ कुछ ही देर तक हनुमान जी के पीछे पीछे गए । तदनन्तर जिस प्रकार दूर देश की यात्रा करने वाले बन्धु के पीछे उसके भाईबंद कुछ दूर तक जाकर लौट ्राते हैं, उसी प्रकार वे वृक्ष भी हनुमान जी को थोड़ी दूर पहुँचा कर लौटे

verses.sloka: तमूरुवेगोन्मथिताःसालाश्चन्ये नगोत्तमाः।अनुजग्मुर्हनूमन्तं सैन्या इव महीपतिम् ॥५-१-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tamūruvegonmathitāḥsālāścanye nagottamāḥ।anujagmurhanūmantaṁ sainyā iva mahīpatim ॥5-1-48॥

translations.english: Uprooted by the force of Hanuman's thighs,great trees like sala followed him just like the troops follow the king.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी की जांघों के वेग से उखड़े साल आदि के बड़े बड़े पेड़ उनके पीछे वसे ही चले जाते थे, जसे राजा के पीछे पीछे सेना चलती हो

verses.sloka: सुपुष्पिताग्रैर्बहुभिः पादपैरन्वितः कपिः ।हनुमान् पर्वताकारो बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः ॥५-१-४९॥
verses.transliteration: supuṣpitāgrairbahubhiḥ pādapairanvitaḥ kapiḥ ।hanumān parvatākāro babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ ॥5-1-49॥

translations.english: With numerous trees laden with flowers following him, Hanuman who looked like a mountain, presented a queer spectable.

verses.sloka: सारवन्तोऽथ ये वृक्षा न्यमज्जन् लवणाम्भसि ।भयादिव महेन्द्रस्य पर्वता वरुणालये ॥५-१-५०॥
verses.transliteration: sāravanto'tha ye vṛkṣā nyamajjan lavaṇāmbhasi ।bhayādiva mahendrasya parvatā varuṇālaye ॥5-1-50॥

translations.english: Then the huge trees sank into the ocean of salt water even as mountains did, afraid of Indra's (thunderbolt).
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी के पीछे उड़ने वाले वृक्षों में जो भारी पेड़ थे, वे समुद्र में गिर कर वैसे ही डूब गए ए जेसे इन्द्र के भय से पहाड़ समुद्र में डूबे थे

verses.sloka: स नानाकुसुमैः कीर्णः कपिः साङ्कुरकोरकैः ।शुशुभे मेघसंकाशः खद्योतैरिव पर्वतः ॥५-१-५१॥
verses.transliteration: sa nānākusumaiḥ kīrṇaḥ kapiḥ sāṅkurakorakaiḥ ।śuśubhe meghasaṁkāśaḥ khadyotairiva parvataḥ ॥5-1-51॥

translations.english: Covered with tender sprouts and buds of different kinds of flowers Hanuman shone brightly like a flying mountain with fireflies.
translations.hindi: उन पेड़ों के फूलों, श्रंकुरों ्रौर कलियों से मेघ के समान कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी वैसे शोभायमान हो रहे थे, जैसे कि जुगुनुश्रों से कोई पर्वत शोमा- यमान हो रहा हो

verses.sloka: विमुक्तास्तस्य वेगेन मुक्त्वा पुष्पाणि ते द्रुमाः ।अवशीर्यन्त सलिले निवृत्ताः सुहृदो यथा ॥५-१-५२॥
verses.transliteration: vimuktāstasya vegena muktvā puṣpāṇi te drumāḥ ।avaśīryanta salile nivṛttāḥ suhṛdo yathā ॥5-1-52॥

translations.english: Shedding their blossoms (under his thrust) the trees dropped into the waters of the sea just like close relatives follow at the time of farewell.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी के गमनवेग से छूट कर वे वृक्ष प्रपने फूलों को गिरा कर श्रोर तितर बितर हो समुद्र के जल में उसी प्रकार गिरे, जिस प्रकार भ्रपने. किसी बंघुजन को पहुँचा कर सुहूद्‌ लोग तितर बितर हो जाते हे

verses.sloka: लघुत्वेनोपपन्नं तद्विचित्रं सागरेऽपतत् ।द्रुमाणां विविधं पुष्पं कपिवायुसमीरितम् ॥५-१-५३॥
verses.transliteration: laghutvenopapannaṁ tadvicitraṁ sāgare'patat ।drumāṇāṁ vividhaṁ puṣpaṁ kapivāyusamīritam ॥5-1-53॥

translations.english: Driven by the wind caused by Hanuman's speed a variety of flowers fell into the ocean because of their light weight and the ocean looked colourful and bright like the starspangled sky.

verses.transliteration: tārācitamivākāśaṁ prababhau ca mahārṇavaḥ ।puṣpaughenānubaddhena nānāvarṇena vānaraḥ ।babhau megha ivākāśe vidyudgaṇavibhūṣitaḥ ॥5-1-54॥

translations.english: Covered with blossoms of different kinds and colours, Hanuman looked like a cloud brightened by lightnings in the sky.

verses.sloka: तस्य वेगसमाधूतैः पुष्पैस्तोयमदृश्यत ॥५-१-५५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya vegasamādhūtaiḥ puṣpaistoyamadṛśyata ॥5-1-55॥

translations.english: The seawater looked splendid with flowers dropped by dint of his speed. It resembled the firmament spangled with enchanting stars just risen in the sky.

verses.sloka: ताराभिरभिरामाभिरुदिताभिरिवाम्बरम् ।तस्याम्बरगतौ बाहू ददृशाते प्रसारितौ ॥५-१-५६॥
verses.transliteration: tārābhirabhirāmābhiruditābhirivāmbaram ।tasyāmbaragatau bāhū dadṛśāte prasāritau ॥5-1-56॥

translations.english: That great Vanara appeared as if he was gulping the entire ocean with its rising waves. While he was looking upward it appeared as though he was keen to drink in the sea as well.
translations.hindi: दोनों नेत्र ऐसे देख पड़ते थे जसे पर्वत पर दो ओर दावानल हों । उनकी पीली पीली झौर बड़ी बड़ी

verses.sloka: पर्वताग्राद्विनिष्क्रान्तौ पञ्चास्याविव पन्नगौ ।पिबन्निव बभौ चापि सोओर्मिमालं महार्णवम् ॥५-१-५७॥
verses.transliteration: parvatāgrādviniṣkrāntau pañcāsyāviva pannagau ।pibanniva babhau cāpi soormimālaṁ mahārṇavam ॥5-1-57॥

translations.english: While he was looking upward, that great vanara appeared as if, parched with thirst, he was gulping the entire ocean with its rising waves.
translations.hindi: मानों पर्वत के शिखर से पांच सिरों वाले दौ साँप निकल रहे हों। आकाश में जाते समय हनुमानजी जब नीचे को मुख करते थे, तब ऐसा जान पड़ता था कि, मानों तरङ्ों से युक्‍त समुद्र को पी डालना चाहते हें

verses.sloka: पिपासुरिव चाकाशं ददृशे स महाकपिः ।तस्य विद्युत्प्रभाकारे वायुमार्गानुसारिणः ॥५-१-५८॥
verses.transliteration: pipāsuriva cākāśaṁ dadṛśe sa mahākapiḥ ।tasya vidyutprabhākāre vāyumārgānusāriṇaḥ ॥5-1-58॥

translations.english: As he was moving in the sky following the direction of the wind, his eyes blazed like two fires burning on the mountain, flashing like lightning.
translations.hindi: और जब वे ऊपर को मुख उठा कर चलते तब ऐसा जान पड़ता, मानों च भाकाश को पी जाना चाहते हं । वायुमागं से जाते हुए हनुमानजी के बिजली की तरह चमकते हुए

verses.sloka: नयने विप्रकाशेते पर्वतस्थाविवानलौ ।पिङ्गे पिङ्गाक्षमुख्यस्य बृहती परिमण्डले ॥५-१-५९॥
verses.transliteration: nayane viprakāśete parvatasthāvivānalau ।piṅge piṅgākṣamukhyasya bṛhatī parimaṇḍale ॥5-1-59॥

translations.english: The large, round, reddishbrown eyes of Hanuman shed their bright light like the rising Moon and Sun.
translations.hindi: जब वे बादल के बाहिर श्राते तब वे घटा से निकले हुए चन्द्रमा की तरह सफेद, नीले, लाल और मंजीठ रंग के

verses.sloka: चक्षुषी संप्रकाशेते चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ ।मुखं नासिकया तस्य ताम्रया ताम्रमाबभौ ॥५-१-६०॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣuṣī saṁprakāśete candrasūryāvivoditau ।mukhaṁ nāsikayā tasya tāmrayā tāmramābabhau ॥5-1-60॥

translations.english: By the reflection of his copperyred nose, his face looked red like the Sun's orb coming close at twilight.
translations.hindi: आँखें आकाश में चन्द्रमा श्रौर सूरये की तरह चमक रही थीं । हनुमानजी की लाल नाक और लाल मुखमण्डल

verses.sloka: सन्ध्यया समभिस्पृष्टं यथा तत्सूर्यमण्डलम् ।लाङ्गूलं च समाविद्धं प्लवमानस्य शोभते ॥५-१-६१॥
verses.transliteration: sandhyayā samabhispṛṣṭaṁ yathā tatsūryamaṇḍalam ।lāṅgūlaṁ ca samāviddhaṁ plavamānasya śobhate ॥5-1-61॥

translations.english: As the son of the Windgod was flying through the sky, his coiled up tail looked splendid like the banner installed at the festival in honour of Indra (on the fifteenth day of the month of Bhadrapada).
translations.hindi: सन्ध्याकालीन सूर्यमण्डल की तरह शोभायमान हो रहा था । श्राकाश- मार्ग से जाते समय हनमानजी की हिलती हु पूछ एसी शोभायमान हो रही थी, जेसे श्राकाश में इन्द्रध्वज । फिर जब कभी वे म्रपनी पूछ का' मण्डलाकार करते थे, तब मुख के सफेद दांतों के साथ साथ उनकी छबि ऐसी जान पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: अम्बरे वायुपुत्रस्य शक्रध्वज इवोच्छ्रितः ।लाङ्गूलचक्रेण महान् शुक्लदंष्ट्रोऽनिलात्मजः ॥५-१-६२॥
verses.transliteration: ambare vāyuputrasya śakradhvaja ivocchritaḥ ।lāṅgūlacakreṇa mahān śukladaṁṣṭro'nilātmajaḥ ॥5-1-62॥

translations.english: With his white teeth and curled up tail, the wise son of the Windgod looked splendid like the halo of the Sungod.
translations.hindi: और सुवणं की चोटी वाले गिरिवर मैनाकपवंत से बोले हे मैनाक ! पातालवासी प्रसुरों को

verses.sloka: व्यरोचत महाप्राज्ञः परिवेषीव भास्करः ।स्फिग्देशेनाभिताम्रेण रराज स महाकपिः ॥५-१-६३॥
verses.transliteration: vyarocata mahāprājñaḥ pariveṣīva bhāskaraḥ ।sphigdeśenābhitāmreṇa rarāja sa mahākapiḥ ॥5-1-63॥

translations.english: The great monkey with copperred buttocks (other parts being dark) looked splendid like a cleft mountain with a huge deposit of minerals shining red.
translations.hindi: जैसी कि सूर्य में मण्डल पड़ने पर सूर्य की छबि, उनकी कमर का पिछला भाग अत्यधिक लाल होने के कारण ऐसा जान पड़ता था, मानों पर्वत में गेरू की खान खुली पड़ी हो । कपिसिह हनुमानजी के समुद्र लाघने के समय

verses.sloka: महता दारितेनेव गिरिर्गैरिकधातुना ।तस्य वानरसिंहस्य प्लवमानस्य सागरम् ॥५-१-६४॥
verses.transliteration: mahatā dāriteneva girirgairikadhātunā ।tasya vānarasiṁhasya plavamānasya sāgaram ॥5-1-64॥

translations.english: The wind passing through the arm pits of the lionlike vanara crossing the ocean sounded like a thundering cloud.
translations.hindi: हिरष्यनाभ--हिरण्यश्ङ्ग । ( गो) |. † षाठान्तरे--“'जातवीर्याणां ।”¬पाठान्तरे--“त्वामुप्ेति i इसीसे तुम श्रसीम पाताल का द्वार रोके रहते हो । हे मैनाक ! लुम सीधे तिरछे, ऊपर नीचे जेसे चाहो वसे बढ़ सकते हो

verses.transliteration: kakṣāntaragato vāyurjīmūta iva garjati ।khe yathā nipatantyulkā hyuttarāntādviniḥsṛtā ॥5-1-65॥

verses.sloka: दृश्यते सानुबन्धा च तथा स कपिकुञ्जरः ।पतत्पतङ्गसंकाशो व्यायतः शुशुभे कपिः ॥५-१-६६॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate sānubandhā ca tathā sa kapikuñjaraḥ ।patatpataṅgasaṁkāśo vyāyataḥ śuśubhe kapiḥ ॥5-1-66॥

translations.english: The vanara expanded into an enormous size form appeared as though moving like the setting Sun. He looked like a huge elephant bound round the waist.
translations.hindi: तब जाते हुए सूर्य की तरह बड़े आकार वाले. कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी झपनी पूछ के कारण कमर में रस्सा बघे हुए महागज कीं तरह शोभायमान होने लगे । आकाश में उडते हुए हनुमान जी के बड़े शरीर और समुद्र के जल में पड़ी हुई उसकी छाया, दोनों मिलकर एसी शोभा दे रहे थे, जैसे वायु के झोको से -काँपती हुई नौका शोभा देती है। हनुमानजी समुद्र के जिस भाग में पहुंचते १

verses.sloka: प्रवृद्ध इव मातङ्गः कक्ष्यया बध्यमानया ।उपरिष्टाच्छरीरेण छायया चावगाढया ।सागरे मारुताविष्टा नौरिवासीत्तदा कपिः ॥५-१-६७॥
verses.transliteration: pravṛddha iva mātaṅgaḥ kakṣyayā badhyamānayā ।upariṣṭāccharīreṇa chāyayā cāvagāḍhayā ।sāgare mārutāviṣṭā naurivāsīttadā kapiḥ ॥5-1-67॥

verses.sloka: यं यं देशं समुद्रस्य जगाम स महाकपिः ।स स तस्योरुवेगेन सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते ॥५-१-६८॥
verses.transliteration: yaṁ yaṁ deśaṁ samudrasya jagāma sa mahākapiḥ ।sa sa tasyoruvegena sonmāda iva lakṣyate ॥5-1-68॥

translations.english: Whichever part of the sea over which that monkey flew, it appeared as though it was riotous with eddies, whirlpools and revolving foam etc., stirred up by the speed of his thighs.

verses.sloka: सागरस्योओर्मिजालानामुरसा शैलवर्ष्मणाम् ।अभिघ्नंस्तु महावेगः पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः ॥५-१-६९॥
verses.transliteration: sāgarasyoormijālānāmurasā śailavarṣmaṇām ।abhighnaṁstu mahāvegaḥ pupluve sa mahākapiḥ ॥5-1-69॥

translations.english: As the great vanara was flying swiftly, the oceanic waves in rows dashing against his chest rose as high as the mountain.
translations.hindi: बहाँ-बहाँ का समुद्र का भाग खलबलाता हुआ सा जान पड़ता था। “वे पर्वत के समान म्रपने-वक्षःस्थल से समुद्र की लहरों को ढकेलते हुए चले जाते थे

verses.sloka: कपिवातश्च बलवान् मेघवातश्च निःसृतः ।सागरं भीमनिर्घोषं कम्पयामासतुर्भृशम् ॥५-१-७०॥
verses.transliteration: kapivātaśca balavān meghavātaśca niḥsṛtaḥ ।sāgaraṁ bhīmanirghoṣaṁ kampayāmāsaturbhṛśam ॥5-1-70॥

translations.english: The forceful wind generated by the monkey moving swiftly, and by the clouds agitated the ocean violently, creating dreadful sounds.
translations.hindi: नोट--इस वर्णन से जान पड़ता है कि हनुमानजी समुद्र के जल की ` -सतह्‌ से बहुत ऊँचे नहीं उड़े थे ।] अ्रभिघ्नंस्तु महावेगः पुप्लुवे स महाकपि: । . कपिवातश्ब बलवान्मेघवातश्च निःसृतः

verses.sloka: विकर्षन्नूर्मिजालानि बृहन्ति लवणाम्भसि ।पुप्लुवे कपिशार्दूलो विकिरन्निव रोदसी ॥५-१-७१॥
verses.transliteration: vikarṣannūrmijālāni bṛhanti lavaṇāmbhasi ।pupluve kapiśārdūlo vikiranniva rodasī ॥5-1-71॥

verses.sloka: मेरुमन्दरसंकाशानुद्धतान् स महार्णवे ।अत्यक्रामन्महावेगस्तरङ्गान् गणयन्निव ॥५-१-७२॥
verses.transliteration: merumandarasaṁkāśānuddhatān sa mahārṇave ।atyakrāmanmahāvegastaraṅgān gaṇayanniva ॥5-1-72॥

translations.english: Hanuman moving along in high speed looked as if he was counting the mighty waves risen ike Meru and Mandara mountains.

verses.transliteration: tasya vegasamuddhūtaṁ jalaṁ sajaladaṁ tadā ।ambarsthaṁ vibabhrāja śāradābhramivātatam ॥5-1-73॥

translations.english: Then the water raised by his onrush along with the cloud widely spread in the sky shone like an outstreched autumnal cloud.

verses.sloka: तिमिनक्रझषाः कूर्मा दृश्यन्ते विवृतास्तदा ।वस्त्रापकर्षणेनेव शरीराणि शरीरिणाम् ॥५-१-७४॥

verses.transliteration: daśayojanavistīrṇā triṁśadyojanamāyatā ।chāyā vānarasiṁhasya jale cārutarābhavat ॥5-1-76॥

translations.english: The broad shadow of the son of the Windgod in the sea following him shone like a dark row of clouds sailing in the pristine sky.

translations.english: Hanuman the great vanara, splendid with a huge body coursing through the air seemed like a winged mountain flying the sky without any support.

verses.sloka: येनासौ याति बलवान् वेगेन कपिकुञ्जरः ।तेन मार्गेण सहसा द्रोणीकृत इवार्णवः ॥५-१-७९॥
verses.transliteration: yenāsau yāti balavān vegena kapikuñjaraḥ ।tena mārgeṇa sahasā droṇīkṛta ivārṇavaḥ ॥5-1-79॥

translations.english: As the powerful monkey, an elephant among vanaras, was proceeding swiftly along, the ocean got instantly transformed into a trough on account of water swelling by the force of his flight.
translations.hindi: आकाश में निरालम्ब और पंख वाले पर्वत की तरह वे सुशोभित हुए । वानरोत्तम बलवान्‌ हनुमानजी जिस मार्ग से बड़े वेग से गमन कर रहे थे,

translations.english: While Hanuman was drawing big clouds which were either white or red or blue or yellow, he looked charming.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी वायु की तरह मेघ समूह को चीरते फाड़ते चले जाते थे ) वे बारंबार बादल के भीतर छिप जाते और बादल के बाहिर प्रकट हो जाते थे

translations.english: Entering into and emerging from the clouds, he looked like the Moon that appears and disappears (behind a bank of clouds).

verses.sloka: प्लवमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्लवङ्गं त्वरितं तदा ।ववर्षुः पुष्पवर्षणि देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ॥५-१-८३॥
verses.transliteration: plavamānaṁ tu taṁ dṛṣṭvā plavaṅgaṁ tvaritaṁ tadā ।vavarṣuḥ puṣpavarṣaṇi devagandharvadānavāḥ ॥5-1-83॥

translations.english: Then seeing Hanuman crossing quickly, the gods, gandharvas and demons rained flowers on him.
translations.hindi: प्राणि चकाशिरे । जान पड़ते थे । व्हपिनाकृष्यमाणानि सहाभ प्लवमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्लवगं त्वरितं तदा

verses.sloka: तताप न हि तं सूर्यः प्लवन्तं वानरोत्तमम् ।सिषेवे च तदा वायू रामकार्याद्थसिद्धये ॥५-१-८४॥
verses.transliteration: tatāpa na hi taṁ sūryaḥ plavantaṁ vānarottamam ।siṣeve ca tadā vāyū rāmakāryādthasiddhaye ॥5-1-84॥

translations.english: The Sun spared Hanuman from the heat and even the Windgod served him, blowing cool while he was taking leaps in order to fulfil Rama's mission.
translations.hindi: देवताओं, गन्धवाँ, और चारणों ने उन पर फूलों की वर्षा की । सूर्यनारायण ग्रपनी किरणों से सन्तप्त नहीं ने भी समुद्र लॉघते समय हनुमानजी को अप किया

verses.transliteration: ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuścaiva plavamānaṁ vihāyasā ।jaguśca devagandharvāḥ praśaṁsanto mahaujasam ॥5-1-85॥

translations.english: The sages praised him while he was coursing through the sky, the gods and gandharvas sang in praise of him extolling his majesty and vigour.

verses.transliteration: nāgāśca tuṣṭuvuryakṣā rakṣāṁsi vibudhāḥ khagāḥ ॥5-1-86॥

verses.transliteration: prekṣya sarve kapivaraṁ sahasā vigataklamam ।tasmin plavagaśārdūle plavamāne hanūmati ॥5-1-87॥

translations.english: While the monkeychief was leaping (across the sea) the Seagod wished the wellbeing of the Ikshvaku family and honoured him. (The Seagod belonged to the same race) :
translations.hindi: भाकाश में कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी को सहसा श्रम-रहित जाते देख, प्रशंसा कर रहे थे । जिस समय प्लंबगशादू ल हनुमानजी समुद्र के पार जाने सगे

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकुकुलमानार्थी चिन्तयामास सागरः ।साहाय्यं वानरेन्द्रस्य यदि नाहं हनूमतः ॥५-१-८८॥
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākukulamānārthī cintayāmāsa sāgaraḥ ।sāhāyyaṁ vānarendrasya yadi nāhaṁ hanūmataḥ ॥5-1-88॥

translations.english: 'If I fail to help the monkeychief, the wise will blame me'.

verses.sloka: करिष्यामि भविष्यामि सर्ववाच्यो विवक्षताम् ।अहमिक्ष्वाकुनाथेन सगरेण विवर्धतः ॥५-१-८९॥
verses.transliteration: kariṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi sarvavācyo vivakṣatām ।ahamikṣvākunāthena sagareṇa vivardhataḥ ॥5-1-89॥

translations.english: 'I expanded on account of a scion of the Ikshvaku race (Sagara) and I should not do anything to make him (Hanuman) suffer since he is the minister helping the Ikshvaku race'.

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकुसचिचश्चायं नावसीदितुमर्हति ।तथा मया विधातव्यं विश्रमेत यथा कपिः ॥५-१-९०॥
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākusacicaścāyaṁ nāvasīditumarhati ।tathā mayā vidhātavyaṁ viśrameta yathā kapiḥ ॥5-1-90॥

translations.english: 'I will have to make arrangements for his rest. Later he can resume his journey comfortably'.

verses.sloka: शेषं च मयि विश्रान्तः सुखेनातिपतिष्यति ।इति कृत्वा मतिं साध्वीं समुद्रश्चन्नमम्भसि ॥५-१-९१॥
verses.transliteration: śeṣaṁ ca mayi viśrāntaḥ sukhenātipatiṣyati ।iti kṛtvā matiṁ sādhvīṁ samudraścannamambhasi ॥5-1-91॥

translations.english: Having resolved in his mind, the Seagod addressed the noble, golden mount Mainaka, hidden in the sea:

verses.sloka: हिरण्यनाभं मैनाकमुवाच गिरिसत्तमम् ।त्वमिहासुरसंघानां पाताLअतलवासिनां ॥५-१-९२॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyanābhaṁ mainākamuvāca girisattamam ।tvamihāsurasaṁghānāṁ pātāLatalavāsināṁ ॥5-1-92॥

translations.english: 'O foremost mountain you are kept here by Indra, lord of the gods as a barrier against the intrusion of demons residing in the netherworld.

verses.sloka: देवराज्ञा गिरिश्रेष्ठ परिघः संनिवेशितः ।त्वमेषां जातवीर्याणां पुनरेवोत्पतिष्यताम् ॥५-१-९३॥
verses.transliteration: devarājñā giriśreṣṭha parighaḥ saṁniveśitaḥ ।tvameṣāṁ jātavīryāṇāṁ punarevotpatiṣyatām ॥5-1-93॥

translations.english: "You are staying at the entrance preventing the violent demons of the immeasurable nether world from jumping onto the surface.
translations.hindi: देवराज्ञा गिरिश्रेष्ठ परिघः सन्निबेशितः । त्वमेषां 'ज्ञातवीर्याणां पुन रेवोत्पतिष्यताम्‌ ।। €३ ॥ रोकने के लिए, इन्द्र ने तुमको यहाँ एक परिघ ( श्रगंल बेड़ा) की _तरह स्थापितं कर रक्खा है; _इससे वे पुनः ऊपर न निकल सकेंगे इन्द्र को इन दैत्यो का पराक्रम मालूम है

verses.sloka: पाताLअस्याप्रमेयस्य द्वारमावृत्य तिष्ठसि ।तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव शक्तिस्ते शैल वर्धितुम् ॥५-१-९४॥
verses.transliteration: pātāLasyāprameyasya dvāramāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi ।tiryagūrdhvamadhaścaiva śaktiste śaila vardhitum ॥5-1-94॥

translations.english: "O noble mountain you have the capacity to grow across, upward and downward by your free will. I therefore prompt you to grow.

verses.sloka: तस्मात्संचोदयामि त्वामुत्तिष्ठ गिरिसत्तम ।न एष कपिशार्दूलस्त्वमुपर्येति वीर्यवान् ॥५-१-९५॥
verses.transliteration: tasmātsaṁcodayāmi tvāmuttiṣṭha girisattama ।na eṣa kapiśārdūlastvamuparyeti vīryavān ॥5-1-95॥

translations.english: "Valiant Hanuman, a tiger among monkeys and a performer of dreadful deeds, is flying over you to fulfil Rama's mission

verses.sloka: हनूमान्रामकार्यार्थं भीमकर्मा खमाप्लुतः ।अस्य साह्यं मया कार्यमिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्तिनः ॥५-१-९६॥
verses.transliteration: hanūmānrāmakāryārthaṁ bhīmakarmā khamāplutaḥ ।asya sāhyaṁ mayā kāryamikṣvākukulavartinaḥ ॥5-1-96॥

translations.english: "I should help him for he is working for the welfare of the Ikshavaku family. The Ikshvaku kings are worthy of adoration to me and for you as well.

verses.sloka: मम हीक्ष्वाकवः पूज्याः परं पूज्यतमास्तव ।कुरु साचिव्यमस्माकं न नः कार्यमतिक्रमेत् ॥५-१-९७॥
verses.transliteration: mama hīkṣvākavaḥ pūjyāḥ paraṁ pūjyatamāstava ।kuru sācivyamasmākaṁ na naḥ kāryamatikramet ॥5-1-97॥

translations.english: "You may act as our minister and let us not miss this chance. Pious men lose their cool if a worthy act is left unfulfilled.

verses.sloka: कर्तव्यमकृतं कार्यं सतां मन्युमुदीरयेत् ।सलिलादूर्ध्वमुत्तिष्ठ तिष्ठत्वेष कपिस्त्वयि ॥५-१-९८॥
verses.transliteration: kartavyamakṛtaṁ kāryaṁ satāṁ manyumudīrayet ।salilādūrdhvamuttiṣṭha tiṣṭhatveṣa kapistvayi ॥5-1-98॥

translations.english: "Rise up from the waters. Let him rest on you since this noble monkey is our guest and worthy of worship.

verses.sloka: अस्माकमतिथिश्चैव पूज्यश्च प्लवतां वरः ।चामीकरमहानाभ देवगन्धर्व सेवित ॥५-१-९९॥
verses.transliteration: asmākamatithiścaiva pūjyaśca plavatāṁ varaḥ ।cāmīkaramahānābha devagandharva sevita ॥5-1-99॥

translations.english: "O goldenpeaked mountainyou are the refuge of the gods and gandharvas. Let him also rest on you for a while before he negotiates the remaining part of the journey.

verses.sloka: हनुमांस्त्वयि विश्रान्तस्ततः शेषं गमिष्यति ।काकुत्थ्सस्यानृशंस्यं च मैथिल्याश्च विवासनम् ॥५-१-१००॥
verses.transliteration: hanumāṁstvayi viśrāntastataḥ śeṣaṁ gamiṣyati ।kākutthsasyānṛśaṁsyaṁ ca maithilyāśca vivāsanam ॥5-1-100॥

translations.english: "You ought to rise up if you consider the nobility of the scion of the Kakusthas, the deportation of Mythili, and the exertion put forth by Hanuman, the lord of monkeys".
translations.hindi: जैसे मेघ को चीर कर चमकते हुए सूर्यदेव उदय होते हें उसी प्रकार समुद्रजल से ढके हुए उस महात्मा मैनाक पंत ने, समुद्र का कहना मान, एक मुहुतं में, अपने वे शिखर पानी के ऊपर निंकाल दिए जो सुवर्णमय थे भर किन्नरों तथा बड़े बड़े उरगों द्वारा सेवित थे ।!8६

verses.sloka: श्रमं च प्लवगेन्द्रस्य समीक्ष्योत्थातुमर्हसि ।हिरण्य नाभो मैनाको निशम्य लवणाम्भसः ॥५-१-१०१॥
verses.transliteration: śramaṁ ca plavagendrasya samīkṣyotthātumarhasi ।hiraṇya nābho maināko niśamya lavaṇāmbhasaḥ ॥5-1-101॥

translations.english: Hearing the command of the god of the ocean, mount Mainaka, rich in gold and covered with trees and creepers rose up at once from the water.
translations.hindi: वे शिखर उदयकालीन प्रकाशमान सूर्यं की तरह थे श्रौर आकाश-स्पर्शी थे । उस पर्वत के तप्तसुवर्ण जैसी श्राभावाले शिखरों के जल के ऊपर निकलने से

verses.sloka: उत्पपात जलात्तूर्णं महाद्रुमलतायुतः ।स सागरजलं भित्त्वा बभूवाभ्युत्थितस्तदा ॥५-१-१०२॥
verses.transliteration: utpapāta jalāttūrṇaṁ mahādrumalatāyutaḥ ।sa sāgarajalaṁ bhittvā babhūvābhyutthitastadā ॥5-1-102॥

translations.english: Just as the rising Sun comes out with glowing rays tearing the veil of dark clouds, the mountain rose up from the water of the ocean.
translations.hindi: नीला श्राकाश सुवर्णमय देख पड़ने लगा । उस समय वह भ्रपनी श्रत्यन्त प्रकाशयुक्त सुनहले शिखरों की प्रभा से शोभायमान हुआ । उस समय सौ सूर्य की तरह उस पवंतश्रेष्ठ मैनाक की शोभा हुई | बिना विलंब किए समुद्र से निकल, आगे खड़े हुए तथा खारी समुद्र के बीच स्थित मैनाक पवंत को देख, हनुमानजी ने भ्रपने मन में यह निश्चित किया कि, यह एक विघ्न था उपस्थित हुआ है । तब उस अत्यन्त ऊँचे उठे हुए मैनाक को हनुमानजी ने बड़े जोर से

verses.sloka: यथा जलधरं भित्त्वा दीप्तरश्मिर्दिवाकरः ।स महात्मा मुहूर्तेन सर्वतः सलिलावृतः ॥५-१-१०३॥
verses.transliteration: yathā jaladharaṁ bhittvā dīptaraśmirdivākaraḥ ।sa mahātmā muhūrtena sarvataḥ salilāvṛtaḥ ॥5-1-103॥

translations.english: At the instance of Varuna, (the presiding deity of the ocean) the lofty mountain appeared, projecting its peaks, hitherto submerged in the water. The golden peaks inhabited by nagas and kinnaras resemmbled the rising Sun as though scraping the sky in a moment.

verses.sloka: द्र्शयामास शृङ्गाणि सागरेण नियोजितः ।शातकुम्भमयैः शृङ्गैः सकिन्नरमहोरगैः ॥५-१-१०४॥
verses.transliteration: drśayāmāsa śṛṅgāṇi sāgareṇa niyojitaḥ ।śātakumbhamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sakinnaramahoragaiḥ ॥5-1-104॥

translations.english: At the instance of Varuna, (the presiding deity of the ocean) the lofty mountain appeared, projecting its peaks, hitherto submerged in the water. The golden peaks inhabited by nagas and kinnaras resemmbled the rising Sun as though scraping the sky in a moment.

verses.sloka: आदित्योदयसंकाशैरालिखद्भिरिवाम्बरम् ।तप्तजाम्बूनदैः शृङिगाः पर्वतस्य समुत्थितैः ॥५-१-१०५॥
verses.transliteration: ādityodayasaṁkāśairālikhadbhirivāmbaram ।taptajāmbūnadaiḥ śṛṅigāḥ parvatasya samutthitaiḥ ॥5-1-105॥

translations.english: The sky shone like barnished weapons smeared with the golden colour of the mountain peaks that rose up above the water.
translations.hindi: ॥। दुष्करं कृतवान्कमं त्वमिदं वानरोत्तम । निपत्य सम 'शङ्गेषु विक्रमस्व यथासुखम्‌ ।। १०८) हे वानरोत्तम ! यह तुमने बड़ा ही दूष्कर काम किया है ग्रतः तुम, मेरे जङ्ग पर कुछ देर तक ठहर. कर विश्राम कर लो । तदनन्तर तुम सुखपुर्वक झागे चले जाना

verses.sloka: आकाशं शस्त्रसंकाशमभवत्काञ्चनप्रभम् ।जातरूपमयैः शृङ्गैर्भ्राजमानैः स्वयंप्रभैः ॥५-१-१०६॥
verses.transliteration: ākāśaṁ śastrasaṁkāśamabhavatkāñcanaprabham ।jātarūpamayaiḥ śṛṅgairbhrājamānaiḥ svayaṁprabhaiḥ ॥5-1-106॥

translations.english: The noble mountain, Mainaka was glittering like a thousand Suns with selfeffulgent golden peaks shining.
translations.hindi: तब मैनाक, हनुमानजी के वेग का भ्रनुभव कर, प्रसन्न हुआ और गर्जा । भैनाक पर्वत फिर भ्राकाश की ओर उठा श्र भ्राकाशस्थित वीर हनुमानजी से, प्रसन्न हो बड़ी प्रीति के साथ मनुष्य का रूप धारण कर तथा भ्रपने शिखर पर खडा होकर बोला

verses.sloka: आदित्यशतसंकाशः सोऽभवद्गिरिसत्तमः ।तमुत्थितमसंगेन हनुमानग्रतः स्थितम् ॥५-१-१०७॥
verses.transliteration: ādityaśatasaṁkāśaḥ so'bhavadgirisattamaḥ ।tamutthitamasaṁgena hanumānagrataḥ sthitam ॥5-1-107॥

translations.english: Hanuman considered the mountain rising up in the midst of the ocean and standing in front an impediment.

verses.sloka: मध्ये लवणतोयस्य विघ्नोऽयमिति निश्चितः ।स तमुच्छ्रित मत्यर्थं महावेगो महाकपिः ॥५-१-१०८॥
verses.transliteration: madhye lavaṇatoyasya vighno'yamiti niścitaḥ ।sa tamucchrita matyarthaṁ mahāvego mahākapiḥ ॥5-1-108॥

translations.english: The great vanara,who was swift in action felled down the mountain that had risen high instantly with his chest just as the wind would strike a cloud.

verses.sloka: उरसा पातयामास जीमूतमिव मारुतः ।स तथा पातितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः ॥५-१-१०९॥
verses.transliteration: urasā pātayāmāsa jīmūtamiva mārutaḥ ।sa tathā pātitastena kapinā parvatottamaḥ ॥5-1-109॥

translations.english: Felled by the vanara's speed, the tall mountain overwhelmed with joy roared in high pitch.

verses.sloka: बुद्ध्वा तस्य कपेर्वेगं जहर्ष च ननन्द च ।तमाकाशगतं वीरमाकाशे समुपस्थितः ॥५-१-११०॥
verses.transliteration: buddhvā tasya kapervegaṁ jaharṣa ca nananda ca ।tamākāśagataṁ vīramākāśe samupasthitaḥ ॥5-1-110॥

translations.english: Now the mountain assumed a human form and standing on its own summit, which stood very high, and glad at heart, addressed the heroic vanara gone to the aerial region.
translations.hindi: कृते च प्रतिकतंस्यमेष घमेः प्तनातन: । सोऽयं तत्प्रतिकारार्थो त्वत्तः \\११०॥ ५3 कक: 2. - f « साराः २३ क्योंकि उपकार क्ररने वाले का उपकार करना यह सनातन धर्म है । सो यह श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का प्रत्युपकार करना चाहता है । प्रत; तुमको समुद्र के सम्मान की रक्षा करनी चाहिए प्रथवा समुद्र की बात मान लेनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: प्रीतो हृष्टमना वाक्यमब्रवीत्पर्वतः कपिम् ।मानुषं धारयन् रूपमात्मनः शिखरे स्थितः ॥५-१-१११॥
verses.transliteration: prīto hṛṣṭamanā vākyamabravītparvataḥ kapim ।mānuṣaṁ dhārayan rūpamātmanaḥ śikhare sthitaḥ ॥5-1-111॥

translations.english: Now the mountain assumed a human form and standing on its own summit, which stood very high, and glad at heart, addressed the heroic vanara gone to the aerial region.
translations.hindi: , तुम्हारा सत्कार करने के लिए समुद्र ने मेरा बड़ा सम्मान कर, मुझे यहाँ भेजा है.। उन्होंने मुझसे कहा है कि, देखो यह कपि सौ योजन जाने के लिए भ्राकाश में उड़े हैं

verses.sloka: दुष्करं कृतावन्कर्म त्वमिदं वानरोत्तम ।निपत्य मम शृङ्गेषु विश्रमस्व यथासुखम् ॥५-१-११२॥
verses.transliteration: duṣkaraṁ kṛtāvankarma tvamidaṁ vānarottama ।nipatya mama śṛṅgeṣu viśramasva yathāsukham ॥5-1-112॥

translations.english: "O best of vanaras you have achieved a formidable deed. Alighting on my peak and comfortably resting awhile, you may resume your journey.
translations.hindi: प्रत: हनुमानजी तुम्हारे शिखर पर विश्रामं कर शेष मागं को पूरा करें ।- सो है कांपशादूल ! तुम यहाँ ठहर कर विश्राम करो । तदनन्तर श्रागे चले जाना

verses.sloka: राघवस्य कुले जातैरुदधिः परिवर्धितः ।स त्वां रामहिते युक्तं प्रत्यर्चयति सागरः ॥५-१-११३॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya kule jātairudadhiḥ parivardhitaḥ ।sa tvāṁ rāmahite yuktaṁ pratyarcayati sāgaraḥ ॥5-1-113॥

translations.english: "The son of Rama's family, Sagara, has extended the ocean in the past.It is most appropriate that he (the god of the sea) honours you in return as you have set out in the service of Rama.

verses.sloka: कृते च प्रतिकर्तव्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः ।सोऽयं तत्प्रतिकारार्थी त्वत्तः संमानमर्हति ॥५-१-११४॥
verses.transliteration: kṛte ca pratikartavyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।so'yaṁ tatpratikārārthī tvattaḥ saṁmānamarhati ॥5-1-114॥

translations.english: When help is rendered it ought to be repaid—this is the eternal law; and he who seeks to do service in return deserves honour from you.
translations.hindi: श्रस्माकमपि सम्बन्धः. कपिमुख्य त्वयास्ति बे । प्रस्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेष महागुणपरिग्रहः ४४१ १४।। ` हे कपियों में प्रधान ! मेरा भी तुम्हारे साथ कुछ सम्बन्ध है भौर तुम तीनों लोकों .में महागुण-ग्राही प्रसिद्ध हो

verses.sloka: त्वन्निमित्तमनेनाहं बहुमानात्प्रचोदितः ।योजनानां शतं चापि कपिरेष समाप्लुतः ॥५-१-११५॥
verses.transliteration: tvannimittamanenāhaṁ bahumānātpracoditaḥ ।yojanānāṁ śataṁ cāpi kapireṣa samāplutaḥ ॥5-1-115॥

translations.english: "I was prompted by the ocean for your sake since he has great regard for you. O great monkey you may rest here for a while and continue your journey. The lord of the ocean feels that this tiger among monkeys can cover the distance of a hundred yojanas. He tells me, 'let him rest on your peak and then cover the rest of the distance'.
translations.hindi: हे पवननन्दन ! इस लोक में जितने कूदने वाले वेगवान्‌ वानर हैं, हे कपीश्वर ! उन सब में, में तुमको मुख्य समझता हूं

verses.sloka: तव सानुषु विश्रान्तः शेषं प्रक्रमतामिति ।तिष्ठ त्वं हरिशार्दूल मयि विश्रम्य गम्यताम् ॥५-१-११६॥
verses.transliteration: tava sānuṣu viśrāntaḥ śeṣaṁ prakramatāmiti ।tiṣṭha tvaṁ hariśārdūla mayi viśramya gamyatām ॥5-1-116॥

translations.english: "I was prompted by the ocean for your sake since he has great regard for you. O great monkey you may rest here for a while and continue your journey. The lord of the ocean feels that this tiger among monkeys can cover the distance of a hundred yojanas. He tells me, 'let him rest on your peak and then cover the rest of the distance'.
translations.hindi: धर्मेजिज्ञासुग्रों के लिए तो एक साधारण अतिथि भी पूज्य है, फिर आपके समान गुणी ग्रतिथि का सत्कार करना तो मुझे सवंथा उचित ही है

verses.sloka: तदिदं गन्धवत्स्वादु कन्दमूलफलं बहु ।तदास्वाद्य हरिश्रेष्ठ विश्रान्तोऽनु गमिष्यसि ॥५-१-११७॥
verses.transliteration: tadidaṁ gandhavatsvādu kandamūlaphalaṁ bahu ।tadāsvādya hariśreṣṭha viśrānto'nu gamiṣyasi ॥5-1-117॥

translations.english: "O foremost of the monkeys after eating plenty of sweet and tasty roots and fruits and resting a while you may go.
translations.hindi: फिर तुम देवताओं में श्रेष्ठ महात्मा पवनदेव के पुत्र हो । हे कपिकुञ्जर ! वेग में भी तुम अ्रपने पिता के समान हीं हो

verses.sloka: अस्माकमपि सम्बन्धः कपिमुख्य त्वयास्ति वै ।प्रख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु महागुणपरिग्रहः ॥५-१-११८॥
verses.transliteration: asmākamapi sambandhaḥ kapimukhya tvayāsti vai ।prakhyātastriṣu lokeṣu mahāguṇaparigrahaḥ ॥5-1-118॥

translations.english: "O chief of monkeys, indeed we too have a relationship with you based on merit which is wellknown to all the three worlds.
translations.hindi: है ष्मज्ञ ! तुम्हारी पूजा करने से पवनदेव का पुजन होगा । श्रतः तुम मेरे पूज्य हो । इसके श्रतिरिवत ग्रौर भी एक कारण तुम्हारे प्रज्य होने का है । उसे भी तुम सुन लो

verses.sloka: वेगवन्तः प्लवन्तो ये प्लवगा मारुतात्मज ।तेषां मुख्यतमं मन्ये त्वामहं कपिकुञ्जर ॥५-१-११९॥
verses.transliteration: vegavantaḥ plavanto ye plavagā mārutātmaja ।teṣāṁ mukhyatamaṁ manye tvāmahaṁ kapikuñjara ॥5-1-119॥

translations.english: "O son of the Windgod you are an elephant among monkeys, the foremost among them who move at a high speed.

verses.sloka: अतिथिः किलपूजार्हः प्राकृतोऽपि विजानता ।धर्मं जिज्ञासमानेन किं पुनस्त्वादृशो महान् ॥५-१-१२०॥
verses.transliteration: atithiḥ kilapūjārhaḥ prākṛto'pi vijānatā ।dharmaṁ jijñāsamānena kiṁ punastvādṛśo mahān ॥5-1-120॥

translations.english: "Even a newcomer, however ordinary, deserves worship by a wise man who wishes to educate himself in the path of righteousness. Needless to say that distinguished guest like you deserves all reverence.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“पुनस्त्वादुशो महान्‌ ।” † पाठान्तरे--“ते हि ।” Dh Fe | पर्वंतों को उडते देख, देवता, ऋषि तथा अन्य समस्त प्राणी उनके ऊपर गिरने की शंका से डर गए थे

verses.sloka: त्वं हि देववरिष्ठस्य मारुतस्य महात्मनः ।पुत्रस्तस्यैव वेगेन सदृशः कपिकुञ्जर ॥५-१-१२१॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṁ hi devavariṣṭhasya mārutasya mahātmanaḥ ।putrastasyaiva vegena sadṛśaḥ kapikuñjara ॥5-1-121॥

translations.english: "O foremost among the vanaras you are the son of the highsouled Windgod's, preeminent among the gods, you are also equal to him in speed.
translations.hindi: तब हजार नेत्रों वाले इन्द्र ने कुपित हो, अपने वस्त्र से इधर उधर घूमने बाले हजारों पहाड़ों के पंख काट डाले

verses.sloka: पूजिते त्वयि धर्मज्ञ पूजां प्राप्नोति मारुतः ।तस्मात्त्वं पूजनीयो मे शृणु चाप्यत्र कारणम् ॥५-१-१२२॥
verses.transliteration: pūjite tvayi dharmajña pūjāṁ prāpnoti mārutaḥ ।tasmāttvaṁ pūjanīyo me śṛṇu cāpyatra kāraṇam ॥5-1-122॥

translations.english: "O knower of righteousness to worship you is to honour the Windgod. Therefore you are worthy of worship for me. I will tell you the reason. Listen.

verses.sloka: पूर्वं कृतयुगे तात पर्वताः पक्षिणोऽभवन् ।ते हि जग्मुर्दिशः सर्वा गरुडानिलवेगिनः ॥५-१-१२३॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṁ kṛtayuge tāta parvatāḥ pakṣiṇo'bhavan ।te hi jagmurdiśaḥ sarvā garuḍānilaveginaḥ ॥5-1-123॥

translations.english: "Formerly in Kritayuga, O dear, mountains were endowed with wings. They used to move speedily in all directions like Garuda and the Windgod.

verses.sloka: ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु देवसंघः सहर्षिभिः ।भूतानि च भयं जग्मुस्तेषां पतनशङ्कया॥५-१-१२४॥
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu prayāteṣu devasaṁghaḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।bhūtāni ca bhayaṁ jagmusteṣāṁ patanaśaṅkayā॥5-1-124॥

translations.english: "When they moved about, even hosts of sages, gods and creatures panicked for fear of falling down (and destroying all worlds).
translations.hindi: ततोऽहं मानयामि त्वां मान्यो हि मम मारुतः । त्वया मे ह्येष सम्बन्धः कपिमुख्य महागुणः ।। १२४ हे पवननन्दन ! इसी से तुम मेरे साथ हो और तुम तो मेरे पूज्य पवनदेव के पुत्र हो दूसरे कपियों में मुख्य ग्रौर बड़े गुणवान होने के कारण मेरे मान्य हो, श्रतः मं तुम्हारी पूजा करता हूँ

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धः सहस्राअक्षः पर्वतानां शतक्रतुः ।पक्षान् चिच्छेद वज्रेण तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः ॥५-१-१२५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddhaḥ sahasrāakṣaḥ parvatānāṁ śatakratuḥ ।pakṣān ciccheda vajreṇa tatra tatra sahasraśaḥ ॥5-1-125॥

translations.english: "Provoked at this, the thousandeyed Indra who had performed a hundred sacrifices cut off the wings of mountains into a thousands pieces with his thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: हे महाकपे ! तुम्हारे ऐसा करने पर मेरी ओर सागर की प्रीति और भी बढ़ेगी भ्रथवा तुम्हारे ऐसा करने पर में श्रौर समुद्र बहुत प्रसन्न होंगे, प्रतः हे महाकपे ! तुम मेरा श्रातिथ्य ग्रहण कर मुझे प्रसन्न करो

verses.sloka: स मामुपागतः क्रुद्धो वज्रमुद्यम्य देवराट् ।ततोऽहं सहसा क्षिप्तः स्वसनेन महात्मना ॥५-१-१२६॥
verses.transliteration: sa māmupāgataḥ kruddho vajramudyamya devarāṭ ।tato'haṁ sahasā kṣiptaḥ svasanena mahātmanā ॥5-1-126॥

translations.english: "Angry Indra held the thunderbolt and came towards me chasing. At that time the great Wind-god tossed me into the air and dropped me down at once.
translations.hindi: हे कपिसत्तम ! तुम अपना श्रम दूर कर, मेरा भ्रातिथ्य ग्रहण कद मुझे प्रसन्न करो । तुम्हें देखकर मुझे बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई है

verses.sloka: अस्मिन्लवणतोये च प्रक्षिप्तः प्लवगोत्तम ।गुप्तपक्षसमग्रश्च तव पित्राभिरक्षितः ॥५-१-१२७॥
verses.transliteration: asminlavaṇatoye ca prakṣiptaḥ plavagottama ।guptapakṣasamagraśca tava pitrābhirakṣitaḥ ॥5-1-127॥

translations.english: "O distinguished vanara your father, the Windgod threw me down into this saltwater sea. Thus my wings were protected.
translations.hindi: एवमुक्तः कपिश्रेष्ठस्तं लगोत्तससब्रवीत्‌ । प्रीतोऽस्मि कृतमातिथ्यं मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम्‌ ।। {२७॥ ज़ब मैनाक ने इस प्रकार कहा तब कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी ने गिरिश्रेष्ठ मैनाक से कहा--मे भ्रापके आतिथ्य से प्रसन्न हूं ।.भ्रापने मेरा सत्कार किया, प्रब भाप प्रपने मन में किसी प्रकार का खेद न.करें

verses.sloka: ततोऽहं मानयामि त्वां मान्यो हि मम मारुतः ।त्वया मे ह्येष संबन्धः कपिमुख्य महागुणः ॥५-१-१२८॥
verses.transliteration: tato'haṁ mānayāmi tvāṁ mānyo hi mama mārutaḥ ।tvayā me hyeṣa saṁbandhaḥ kapimukhya mahāguṇaḥ ॥5-1-128॥

translations.english: "O esteemed vanara the Windgod is revered by me and so I honour you. O chief of monkeys, my bondage with you is therefore of high value to me, indeed.
translations.hindi: एक तो मुझे कार्यं करने की त्वरा है । दूसरे समय भी बहुत हो. चुका है । तींसरे मैने वानरों के सामने यह प्रतिज्ञा भी की है कि मैं बीच में कहीं न ठहरूंगा

verses.sloka: अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये सागरस्य ममैव च ।प्रीतिं प्रीतमनाः कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि महाकपे ॥५-१-१२९॥
verses.transliteration: asminnevaṁgate kārye sāgarasya mamaiva ca ।prītiṁ prītamanāḥ kartuṁ tvamarhasi mahākape ॥5-1-129॥

translations.english: "O great monkey when I hold you so high, you ought to oblige me and the (god of the) ocean wholeheartedly (and accept our hospitalty).

verses.sloka: श्रमं मोक्षय पूजां च गृहाण कपिसत्तम ।प्रीतिं च बहुमन्यस्व प्रीतोऽस्मि तव दर्शनात् ॥५-१-१३०॥
verses.transliteration: śramaṁ mokṣaya pūjāṁ ca gṛhāṇa kapisattama ।prītiṁ ca bahumanyasva prīto'smi tava darśanāt ॥5-1-130॥

translations.english: "O noble monkey oblige us by accepting our offering given with love and be relieved of your fatigue. Your presence itself is welcome to me".
translations.hindi: यह कह कर कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी ने मैनाक को हाथ सेछुम्रा । तदनन्तर पराक्रमी हनुमानजी हेसते हुए आकाश में उड़ चले ।। १:२६।। स्‌ पर्वंतसमुद्राम्यां बहुमानादवेक्षितः । . पूजितश्चोपपन्नाभिराशीभिरनिलात्मजः

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तः कपिश्रेष्ठस्तं नगोत्तममब्रवीत् ।प्रीतोऽस्मि कृतमातिथ्यं मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम् ॥५-१-१३१॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ kapiśreṣṭhastaṁ nagottamamabravīt ।prīto'smi kṛtamātithyaṁ manyureṣo'panīyatām ॥5-1-131॥

translations.english: The great Hanuman, pleased with the words of Mainaka, said "I am pleased at your hospitality. Remove your unhappiness.

verses.sloka: त्वरते कार्यकालो मे अहश्चाप्यतिवर्तते ।प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता न स्थातव्यमिहान्त्तरे ॥५-१-१३२॥
verses.transliteration: tvarate kāryakālo me ahaścāpyativartate ।pratijñā ca mayā dattā na sthātavyamihānttare ॥5-1-132॥

translations.english: "My commitment is hastening me. The day set (for the accomplishment of the task) is also drawing to a close. A vow is made and I will not halt in the middle of my work."

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा पाणिना शैलमालभ्य हरिपुङ्गवः ।जगामाकाशमाविश्य वीर्यवान् प्रहसन्निव ॥५-१-१३३॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā pāṇinā śailamālabhya haripuṅgavaḥ ।jagāmākāśamāviśya vīryavān prahasanniva ॥5-1-133॥

translations.english: Having said this, the mighty monkey gently touched the mountain with his hands before ascending to the sky with a smile on his face.

verses.sloka: स पर्वतसमुद्राभ्यां बहुमानादवेक्षितः ।पूजितश्चोपपन्नाभिराशीर्भिरनिलात्मजः ॥५-१-१३४॥
verses.transliteration: sa parvatasamudrābhyāṁ bahumānādavekṣitaḥ ।pūjitaścopapannābhirāśīrbhiranilātmajaḥ ॥5-1-134॥

translations.english: The mountain and the sea honoured and adored the son of the Windgod and gave him appropriate blessings.
translations.hindi: देवताश्चाभवन्हव्टास्तत्रस्थास्तस्य कर्मणा । काञ्चनस्य सुनाभस्य सहस्राक्षश्च वासवः ॥१ ३४ . उस समय वहाँ जो देवता उपस्थित थे तथा ने T द्‌ सहल्ननत्र सुवर्णश्वृङ्ग वाले मैनाक के इस कार्य से उनके ऊपर बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: अथोर्ध्वं दूरमुत्प्लुत्य हित्वा शैलमहार्णवौ ।पितुः पन्थानमास्थाय जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे ॥५-१-१३५॥
verses.transliteration: athordhvaṁ dūramutplutya hitvā śailamahārṇavau ।pituḥ panthānamāsthāya jagāma vimale'mbare ॥5-1-135॥

translations.english: And thereafter leaping a long distance into the clear sky, he (Hanuman) took the path of the Windgod, his father, leaving behind the mountain and the sea.
translations.hindi: शचीपति देवराज इन्द्र स्वयं सुवणं शृङ्ग २ वाले पंत श्रेष्ठ १ ही, गद्गद वाणी से बोले

verses.sloka: भूयश्चोर्ध्वं गतिं प्राप्य गिरिं तमवलोकयन् ।वायुसूनुर्निरालम्बे जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे ॥५-१-१३६॥
verses.transliteration: bhūyaścordhvaṁ gatiṁ prāpya giriṁ tamavalokayan ।vāyusūnurnirālambe jagāma vimale'mbare ॥5-1-136॥

translations.english: Rising higher and further up and looking at the mountain (which was going down into the ocean), the son of the Windgod coursed through the cloudless sky unsupported.
translations.hindi: हे सुवर्ण शिखरों बाले झैलेन्द्र ! म॑ तुम्हारे ऊपर बहुत प्रसन्न हुन्ना । में तुझको श्रभय वर देता हूं । हे सौम्य ! तू भ्रब' जहाँ चाहे वहाँ सुखपूवक रह सकता है

verses.sloka: तद्द्वितीयं हनुमतो दृष्ट्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् ।प्रश्शंसुः सुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ॥५-१-१३७॥
verses.transliteration: taddvitīyaṁ hanumato dṛṣṭvā karma suduṣkaram ।praśśaṁsuḥ surāḥ sarve siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ॥5-1-137॥

translations.english: Gods, siddhas as well as the great sages praised him for the second great achievment of Hanuman, which is impossible for others to accomplish.
translations.hindi: हे सौम्य ! भय रहते पराक्रमी हनुमानजी को निर्भीक हो सौ योजन समद्र के पार जाते देख तथा उनको बीच में विश्राम करने का अवसर दे, तूने उनकी बड़ी सहायता की है

verses.sloka: देवताश्चाभवन् हृष्टास्तत्रस्थास्तस्य कर्मणा ।काञ्चनस्य सुनाभस्य सहस्राक्षश्च वासवः ॥५-१-१३८॥
verses.transliteration: devatāścābhavan hṛṣṭāstatrasthāstasya karmaṇā ।kāñcanasya sunābhasya sahasrākṣaśca vāsavaḥ ॥5-1-138॥

translations.english: The gods who happened to be present at that time (on the mountain) and the thousandeyed Indra were delighted by the gesture of golden Sunabha (Mainaka) mountain.

verses.sloka: उवाच वचनं धीमान् परितोषात्सगद्गदम् ।सुनाभं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं स्वयमेव शचीपतिः ॥५-१-१३९॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṁ dhīmān paritoṣātsagadgadam ।sunābhaṁ parvataśreṣṭhaṁ svayameva śacīpatiḥ ॥5-1-139॥

translations.english: Indra, the lord of Sachi, was personally satisfied and spoke to Mainaka, the best of mountains, in faltering tone, his throat choked out of joy.

verses.sloka: हिरण्यनाभ शैलेन्द्र परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते भृशम् ।अभयं ते प्रयच्छामि तिष्ठ सौम्य यथासुखम् ॥५-१-१४०॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyanābha śailendra parituṣṭo'smi te bhṛśam ।abhayaṁ te prayacchāmi tiṣṭha saumya yathāsukham ॥5-1-140॥

translations.english: "O Hiranyanabha, the foremost among the mountains I am highly pleased with you. I give you security (free from fear of losing wings). O pious one you may stay on happily as you please.
translations.hindi: इन्द्र से ग्रभयदान प्राप्त कर, मैनाक सुस्थिर हुआ । उघर हनुमानजी भी मैनाक श्रधिकृत समुद्र के भाग को मुहुत्तं मात्र में पार कर गए

verses.sloka: साह्यं ते सुमहद्विक्रान्तस्य हनूमतः ।क्रमतो योजनशतं निर्भयस्य भये सति ॥५-१-१४१॥
verses.transliteration: sāhyaṁ te sumahadvikrāntasya hanūmataḥ ।kramato yojanaśataṁ nirbhayasya bhaye sati ॥5-1-141॥

translations.english: "You have rendered very valuable help to Hanuman who was attempting to leap a distance of a hundred yojanas. He is fearless even when there is reason to fear (of falling down).
translations.hindi: ahali mukh Library, प्रथम: सर्ग : ) २६ तब तो देवताग्रों, गन्धवों, सिद्धों ग्रौर महघियो ने सूर्य के समान प्रकाश वाली नागों की माता सुरसा से कहा

verses.sloka: रामस्यैष हितायैव याति दाशरथेर्हरिः ।सत्क्रियां कुर्वता तस्य तोषितोऽस्मि दृढं त्वया ॥५-१-१४२॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasyaiṣa hitāyaiva yāti dāśaratherhariḥ ।satkriyāṁ kurvatā tasya toṣito'smi dṛḍhaṁ tvayā ॥5-1-142॥

translations.english: "The vanara has gone on a mission to help the son of Dasaratha. I am highly pleased with the service rendered to him.
translations.hindi: पवननन्दन हनुमानजी समुद्र के पार जाने के लिए आकाश मारग से चले जा रहे हैं । अतः तू उनके गमन में एक मूहुतं के लिए विघ्न डाल

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहर्षमगमद्विपुलं पर्वतोत्तमः ।देवतानां पतिं दृष्ट्वा परितुष्टं शतक्रतुम् ॥५-१-१४३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praharṣamagamadvipulaṁ parvatottamaḥ ।devatānāṁ patiṁ dṛṣṭvā parituṣṭaṁ śatakratum ॥5-1-143॥

translations.english: Thereafter Mainaka, the great mountain was delighted to see Indra, lord of the gods, performer of a hundred yajnas satisfied.

verses.sloka: स वै दत्तवरः शैलो बभूवावस्थितस्तदा ।हनुमांश्च मुहूर्तेन व्यतिचक्राम सागरम् ॥५-१-१४४॥
verses.transliteration: sa vai dattavaraḥ śailo babhūvāvasthitastadā ।hanumāṁśca muhūrtena vyaticakrāma sāgaram ॥5-1-144॥

translations.english: Then mount Mainaka, assured by Indra became secure. And Hanuman also crossed over the ocean in a short while.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि हम सब हनुमानजी के बल और पराक्रम की परीक्षा ही लेना चाहते हैं। या तो हनुमानजी तुझको किसी उपाय से जीत लेंगे प्रथवा दुःखी हो कर चले जायेंगे

verses.sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।अब्रूवन् सूर्यसंकाशां सुरसां नागमातरम् ॥५-१-१४५॥
verses.transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।abrūvan sūryasaṁkāśāṁ surasāṁ nāgamātaram ॥5-1-145॥

translations.english: Then the gods, gandharvas, siddhas and great sages approached Surasa, the mother of nagas, who was glowing like the Sungod and said:.
translations.hindi: जब देवताओं ने सुरसा से आदरपूर्वक इस प्रकार कहा, तब सुरसा राक्षसी का रूप धर, समुद्र के बीच जा खड़ी हुई

verses.sloka: अयं वातात्मजः श्रीमान्प्लवते सागरोपरि ।हनुमान्नाम तस्य त्वं मुहूर्तं विघ्नमाचर ॥५-१-१४६॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ vātātmajaḥ śrīmānplavate sāgaropari ।hanumānnāma tasya tvaṁ muhūrtaṁ vighnamācara ॥5-1-146॥

translations.english: "The glorious son of the Windgod, called Hanuman, is crossing the ocean. Obstruct him for sometime by assuming the hideous form of a demon, gigantic as a mountain, fearful with yellowishbrown eyes, with big teeth and a wide mouth like the sky.
translations.hindi: उस समय का सुरसा का रूप ऐसा विकट भ्रौर भयंकर था कि, जिसे देख सब को डर लगता था । सुरसा, समुद्र के पार जाते हुए हनुमानजी का रास्ता छक कर, उनसे कहने लगी

verses.sloka: राक्षसं रूपमास्थाय सुघोरं पर्वतोपमम् ।दंष्ट्रकराLअं पिङ्गाक्षं वक्त्रं कृत्वा नभःसमम् ॥५-१-१४७॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasaṁ rūpamāsthāya sughoraṁ parvatopamam ।daṁṣṭrakarāLaṁ piṅgākṣaṁ vaktraṁ kṛtvā nabhaḥsamam ॥5-1-147॥

translations.english: "The glorious son of the Windgod, called Hanuman, is crossing the ocean. Obstruct him for sometime by assuming the hideous form of a demon, gigantic as a mountain, fearful with yellowishbrown eyes, with big teeth and a wide mouth like the sky.

verses.sloka: बलमिच्छामहे ज्ञातुं भूयश्चास्य पराक्रमम् ।त्वां विजेष्यत्युपायेन विषादं वा गमिष्यति ॥५-१-१४८॥
verses.transliteration: balamicchāmahe jñātuṁ bhūyaścāsya parākramam ।tvāṁ vijeṣyatyupāyena viṣādaṁ vā gamiṣyati ॥5-1-148॥

translations.english: "We want to assess his strength, valour and intelligence once again. We wish to know whether he will win or give way to despondency".
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे सम भक्ष्यः प्रदिष्टस्त्वसीश्वरर्वानरषभ । ग्रहं त्वां भक्षयिष्यासि प्रविशेदं ममाननम्‌ ।। १४७१ हे वानरश्रेष्ठ ! ईश्वर ने तुमको मेरा भक्ष्य बनाया है । इसलिए में तुमको खा जाऊंगी । ग्रा तू प्रब मेरे मुख में घुस ।'१४७।। एवमुक्तः सुरसया प्राञ्जलिर्वानरषंभः । प्रहृष्टवदनः *भरीमान्सुंरसां दाक्यसञ्नबोत्‌

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी दैवतैरभिसत्कृता ।समुद्रमध्ये सुरसा बिभ्रती राक्षसं वपुः ॥५-१-१४९॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu sā devī daivatairabhisatkṛtā ।samudramadhye surasā bibhratī rākṣasaṁ vapuḥ ॥5-1-149॥

translations.english: Thus honoured by the gods, Surasa assumed a terrific ugly form frightening to all and stood in the midst of the ocean. Putting up a distorted appearance and encompassing Hanuman who was crossing the ocean, she spoke to him:

verses.sloka: विकृतं च विरूपं च सर्वस्य च भयावहम् ।प्लवमानं हनूमन्तमावृत्येदमुवाच ह ॥५-१-१५०॥
verses.transliteration: vikṛtaṁ ca virūpaṁ ca sarvasya ca bhayāvaham ।plavamānaṁ hanūmantamāvṛtyedamuvāca ha ॥5-1-150॥

translations.english: Thus honoured by the gods, Surasa assumed a terrific ugly form frightening to all and stood in the midst of the ocean. Putting up a distorted appearance and encompassing Hanuman who was crossing the ocean, she spoke to him:
translations.hindi: झौर कारणान्तर से उनसे और राक्षसों से परस्पर शत्रुता हो गई । ससे रावण उनकी तपस्विनी भार्या सीता को हर कर ले गया

verses.sloka: मम भक्षः प्रदिष्टस्त्वमीश्वरैर्वानरर्षभ ।अहं त्वा भक्षयिष्यामि प्रविशेदं ममाननम् ॥५-१-१५१॥
verses.transliteration: mama bhakṣaḥ pradiṣṭastvamīśvarairvānararṣabha ।ahaṁ tvā bhakṣayiṣyāmi praviśedaṁ mamānanam ॥5-1-151॥

translations.english: "O bull among vanaras the lords of the universe have provided you as food for me. I will eat you. Enter my mouth".

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तः सुरसया प्राञ्जलिर्वानरर्षभः ।प्रहृष्टवदनः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-१-१५२॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ surasayā prāñjalirvānararṣabhaḥ ।prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrīmānidaṁ vacanamabravīt ॥5-1-152॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Surasa, the glorious Hanuman said this with a blooming face and folded hands:
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की आज्ञा से में सीताजी के पास दूत बन कर जा रहा हूँ । तू श्रीरामचन्द्रजीःके राज्य में बसने वाली है, अतः तुझे तो मेरी सहा- यता करनी चाहिए-॥ १.५ १।। ङ पाठान्तरे--श्रोमानिदं वच्ननमग्रवीत्‌ ।” † पाठान्तरे--“दाशरथिर्नाम ।” १ झन्यकायंविषक्तस्य--मारीघमृगग्रहणक्रासक्तस्य। [गो०] अथवा मेथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम्‌ । आगभिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिश्ुणोमि ते

verses.sloka: रामो दाशरथिर्नाम प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या चापि भार्यया ॥५-१-१५३॥
verses.transliteration: rāmo dāśarathirnāma praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā cāpi bhāryayā ॥5-1-153॥

translations.english: "Dasaratha's son called Rama accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and his wife Vaidehi entered Dandaka forest.
translations.hindi: जब हनुमानजी ने इस प्रकार उससे कहा, तब वह्‌ कामरूपिणी सुरसा हनुमानजी को जाते देख, उनसे बोली

verses.sloka: अन्यकार्यविषक्तस्य बद्धवैरस्य राक्षसैः ।तस्य सीत हृता भार्या रावणेन यशस्विनी ॥५-१-१५४॥
verses.transliteration: anyakāryaviṣaktasya baddhavairasya rākṣasaiḥ ।tasya sīta hṛtā bhāryā rāvaṇena yaśasvinī ॥5-1-154॥

translations.english: "While Rama was engaged otherwise, his glorious wife Sita was abducted by Ravana actuated by deeprooted enmity of demons with him.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी के बल की परीक्षा लेती हुई नागमाता बोली कि, हे हनुमान ! मुझको ब्रह्माजी ने यह बर,दे रखा है.कि, मेरे श्रागे से कोई जीता जागता नहीं जा सकता

verses.sloka: तस्याः सकाशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामकारणात् ।कर्तुमर्हसि रामस्य साह्यं विषयवासिनि ॥५-१-१५५॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ sakāśaṁ dūto'haṁ gamiṣye rāmakāraṇāt ।kartumarhasi rāmasya sāhyaṁ viṣayavāsini ॥5-1-155॥

translations.english: "I am going as Rama's emissary to search for his wife. It is proper for you to render help since you are a resident of his kingdom.
translations.hindi: हे वानरोत्तम ! पहिले तुम मेरे मुख में प्रबेश करो, फिर तुरंत चले जाना । विधाता ने मुझे पुर्वकाल में यही वरदान दिया था

verses.sloka: अथवा मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते ॥५-१-१५६॥
verses.transliteration: athavā maithilīṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṁ cākliṣṭakāriṇam ।āgamiṣyāmi te vaktraṁ satyaṁ pratiśṛṇomi te ॥5-1-156॥

translations.english: Or else, after seeing Maithili and the ever-untroubled Rama, I shall return into your mouth—this I truly promise you.
translations.hindi: यह कह कर नागमाता सुरसा, श्रपना बड़ा भारी मुख फैला, हनुमान जी के सामने खड़ी हो गई। सुरसा के ऐसे वचन सुन कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी छुद्ध हुए

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सुरसा कामरूपिणी ।अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम ॥५-१-१५७॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā surasā kāmarūpiṇī ।abravīnnātivarteta kaścideṣa varo mama ॥5-1-157॥

translations.english: Having heard Hanuman, Surasa capable of taking any form at her free will told him that no one can cross (her region) as she had been given such a boon(by the Creator)৷৷
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने उससे कहा कि, तू अपना मुख उतना बड़ा फैला जिसमें कि मैं समा सक्‌ । यह सुन सुरसा ने क्रुद्ध हो अपना मुख दशयोजन फँलाया

verses.sloka: तं प्रयान्तं समुद्वीक्ष्य सुरसा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।बलं जिज्ञासमाना वै नागमाता हनूमतः ॥५-१-१५८॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ prayāntaṁ samudvīkṣya surasā vākyamabravīt ।balaṁ jijñāsamānā vai nāgamātā hanūmataḥ ॥5-1-158॥

translations.english: Surasa, mother of serpents, observing that Hanuman was attempting to escape, said this in order to gauge his strength:

verses.sloka: प्रविश्य वदनं मेऽद्य गन्तव्यं वानरोत्तम ।वर एष पुरा दत्तो मम धात्रेति सत्वरा ॥५-१-१५९॥
verses.transliteration: praviśya vadanaṁ me'dya gantavyaṁ vānarottama ।vara eṣa purā datto mama dhātreti satvarā ॥5-1-159॥

translations.english: "O best vanara you must pass through my mouth today. Such is the boon granted to me by Brahma in the past". Then she quickly opened her big mouth and stood.

verses.sloka: व्यादाय विपुलं वक्त्रं स्थिता सा मारुतेः पुरः ।एवमुक्तः सुरसया क्रुद्धो वानरपुञ्गवः ॥५-१-१६०॥
verses.transliteration: vyādāya vipulaṁ vaktraṁ sthitā sā māruteḥ puraḥ ।evamuktaḥ surasayā kruddho vānarapuñgavaḥ ॥5-1-160॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Surasa, Hanuman the supreme vanara said, "Open your mouth wide enough to hold me."
translations.hindi: तब सुरसा ने अपना मुख चालीस योजन चौडा किया । इस पर हनुमान जी ने अपता शरीर पचास योचन ऊंचा कर लिया

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत्कुरु वै वक्त्रं येन मां विषहिष्यसे ।प्रविश्य वदनं मेऽद्य ग्न्तव्यं वानरोत्तम ।वर एष पुरा दत्तो ममम् ध्रात्रेति सत्वरा ॥५-१-१६१॥
verses.transliteration: abravītkuru vai vaktraṁ yena māṁ viṣahiṣyase ।praviśya vadanaṁ me'dya gntavyaṁ vānarottama ।vara eṣa purā datto mamam dhrātreti satvarā ॥5-1-161॥

translations.english: Provoked by the words of Surasa, Hanuman stretched himself to ten yojanas.

verses.sloka: व्यादाय विपुलं वक्त्रं स्थिता सा मरुतेः पुरः ।तं दृष्ह्ट्वा मेघसंकाशं दशयोजनमायतम् ॥५-१-१६२॥
verses.transliteration: vyādāya vipulaṁ vaktraṁ sthitā sā maruteḥ puraḥ ।taṁ dṛṣhṭvā meghasaṁkāśaṁ daśayojanamāyatam ॥5-1-162॥

translations.english: Seeing his body stretched to ten yojanas like a cloud, Surasa also widened her mouth to twenty yojanas.
translations.hindi: इस पर जब सुरसा ने अपना मुख अस्सी योजन का किया तब हनुमान जी बृहदाकार पर्वत की तरह, नब्बे योजन लम्बे हो गए

verses.sloka: चकार सुरसा चास्यं विंशद्योजनमायतम् ।हनुमांस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्त्रिंशद्योजनमायतः ॥५-१-१६३॥
verses.transliteration: cakāra surasā cāsyaṁ viṁśadyojanamāyatam ।hanumāṁstu tataḥ kruddhastriṁśadyojanamāyataḥ ॥5-1-163॥

translations.english: Provoked, Hanuman further stretched his body to thirty yojanas and Surasa on her own enlarged her mouth to forty yojanas. Then the great hero Hanuman stretched his body to fifty yojanas.
translations.hindi: इस पर जब सुरसा ने ग्रपना मुख सो योजन फेलाया; तब बुद्धिमान्‌ वायुनन्दन हनुमानजी ने उसके उस सौ योजन फेले हुए बड़ी जिह्वा से युक्त, भयंकर श्रौर नरक जैसे मुख को देख, मेघ जैसे भ्रपने विशाल शरीर को समेटा श्रौर वे तत्क्षण अँगूठे के बराबर छोटे शरीर वाले हो गए । तदनन्तर वे महाबली उसके मुख में प्रवेश कर, तुरन्त उसके बाहिर निकल ग्राए

verses.sloka: चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं चत्वारिंशत्तथोच्छ्रितम् ।बभूव हनुमान्वीरः पञ्चाशद्योजनोच्छ्रितः ॥५-१-१६४॥
verses.transliteration: cakāra surasā vaktraṁ catvāriṁśattathocchritam ।babhūva hanumānvīraḥ pañcāśadyojanocchritaḥ ॥5-1-164॥

translations.english: Provoked, Hanuman further stretched his body to thirty yojanas and Surasa on her own enlarged her mouth to forty yojanas. Then the great hero Hanuman stretched his body to fifty yojanas.

verses.sloka: चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं षष्टियोजनमायतम् ।तथैव हनुमान्वीरः सप्ततीयोजिनोच्छ्रितः ॥५-१-१६५॥
verses.transliteration: cakāra surasā vaktraṁ ṣaṣṭiyojanamāyatam ।tathaiva hanumānvīraḥ saptatīyojinocchritaḥ ॥5-1-165॥

translations.english: Surasa widened her mouth sixty yojanas and then the heroic Hanuman enlarged himself to seventy yojanas.

verses.sloka: चकार सुरसा व्क्त्रम्शीतीयोजनोच्छ्रितम् ।हनुमानचलप्रख्यो नवतीयोजनोच्छ्रितः ॥५-१-१६६॥
verses.transliteration: cakāra surasā vktramśītīyojanocchritam ।hanumānacalaprakhyo navatīyojanocchritaḥ ॥5-1-166॥

translations.english: Surasa widened her mouth to eighy yojanas and the heroic Hanuman grew up to ninety yojanas, looking like a mountain.
translations.hindi: श्रौर श्राकाश में खड़े हो, हंसते हुए यह बोले- हे दाक्षायणि ! तुझको नमस्कार है । में तेरे मुख में प्रवेश कर चुका

verses.sloka: तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं त्वास्यं वायुपुत्रः सुबुद्धिमान् ।दीर्घजिह्वं सुरसया सुघोरं नरकोपमम् ॥५-१-१६७॥
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā vyāditaṁ tvāsyaṁ vāyuputraḥ subuddhimān ।dīrghajihvaṁ surasayā sughoraṁ narakopamam ॥5-1-167॥

translations.english: Intelligent Hanuman observing Surasa's enlarged mouth open and dreadful like hell with a long tongue, suddenly shrunk his body to the size of a thumb.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“वास्य ।” २ पाठान्तरे--''महाजंबः ।” ३४ सुन्दरकाण्डे तेरा बरदान सत्य हो गया । भ्रब-म॑ वहाँ जाता हूँ, जहाँ सीता जी हँ । राहु के मुख से चन्द्रमा के समान, हनुमानजी को म्रपने मुख से निकला हुआ देख,

verses.sloka: सुसंक्षिप्यात्मनः कायं बभूवाञ्गुष्ठमात्रकः ।सोऽभिपत्याशु तद्वक्त्रं निष्पत्य च महाजवः ।अन्तरिक्षे स्थितः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-१-१६८॥
verses.transliteration: susaṁkṣipyātmanaḥ kāyaṁ babhūvāñguṣṭhamātrakaḥ ।so'bhipatyāśu tadvaktraṁ niṣpatya ca mahājavaḥ ।antarikṣe sthitaḥ śrīmānidaṁ vacanamabravīt ॥5-1-168॥

translations.english: Glorious and mighty Hanuman quickly went into her mouth and got out and stood in the sky and said:.
translations.hindi: श्रव तुम निर्विष्न हो श्रपना कायं सिद्ध करो । हे वानरेन्द्र ! तुम्हारी तरह जिसमें धीरता, सूक्ष्मदृष्टि, बुद्धि और चतुराई, ये चार गुण होते हैं, वह्‌ कभी किसी काम के करने में नहीं घबड़ाता । ये चारों गुण तुममें मौजूद हँ । पूज्य हनुमानजी उन प्राणियों से पूजित श्रोर श्रपने कार्य की सिद्धि के विषय में निश्चित से हो
