translations.english: Hanuman passed through the path of wind like Garuda. The region was refreshed with clouds that released torrents of rain and frequented by birds. It was splendid with god at fire who strikes fiercely like thunderbolt. It was inhabited by great sages who had acquired merit. translations.english: Seeing the form with a hideous countenance, Hanuman reflected about the creature of ugly appearance endowed with power which can catch a creature though his shadow, about which king Sugriva had once told him. 'It is the same creature, no doubt', said Hanuman.
translations.hindi: छायाग्राहि महावीयं तदिदं नात्र संशयः । स तां बुद्ध्वाऽर्थतत्त्वेन सिंहिकां मतिमान्कपिः ।। १८८ व्यवर्धत महाकायः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः । तस्य सा कायमुद्वीक्ष्म वर्धमानं महाकपेः ।। १८६ उस बिकराल मख वाले जन्तु को देख जब हनुमानजी ने भ्रपने मन सै बिचार किया, तब इन्हें कपिराज सुग्रीव की बात याद पड़ी ग्रौर उन्होंने निश्चय किया कि, श्रदूभुत सूरत वाला और छाया पकड़ने वाला महाबली जीव निस्सन्देह यही है । इस प्रकार उसके कर्म को देख, बुद्धिमान्‌ हनुमानजी उस सिंहिका को पहचान कर वर्षाकाल के बादल की तरह बढ़े । जब सिंहिका ने हनुमान के शरीर को बढ़ता हुंश्रा देखा

verses.sloka: आग्राहि महावीर्यं तदिदं नात्र संशयः ।स तां बुद्ध्वार्थतत्त्वेन सिंहिकां मतिमान्कपिः ।व्यवर्धत महाकायः प्रवृषीव वलाहकः ॥५-१-१८८॥
verses.transliteration: āgrāhi mahāvīryaṁ tadidaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ।sa tāṁ buddhvārthatattvena siṁhikāṁ matimānkapiḥ ।vyavardhata mahākāyaḥ pravṛṣīva valāhakaḥ ॥5-1-188॥

translations.english: Recognising the true nature of Simhika the clutcher of shadows, the wise Hanuman grew to a huge size like a cloud in rainy season.

verses.sloka: तस्य सा कायमुद्वीक्ष्य वर्धमानं महाकपेः ॥५-१-१८९॥
verses.transliteration: tasya sā kāyamudvīkṣya vardhamānaṁ mahākapeḥ ॥5-1-189॥

translations.english: Observing the body of Hanuman growing in size, Simhika started distending her mouth wide like the depth of the underworld.

verses.sloka: वक्त्रं प्रसारयामास पाताLआन्तरसन्निभम् ।घनराजीव गर्जन्ती वानरं सम्भिद्रवत् ॥५-१-१९०॥
verses.transliteration: vaktraṁ prasārayāmāsa pātāLāntarasannibham ।ghanarājīva garjantī vānaraṁ sambhidravat ॥5-1-190॥

translations.english: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.

verses.sloka: स ददर्श ततस्तस्या विवृतं सुमहन्मुखम् ।कायमात्रं च मेधावी मर्माणि च महाकपिः ॥५-१-१९१॥
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa tatastasyā vivṛtaṁ sumahanmukham ।kāyamātraṁ ca medhāvī marmāṇi ca mahākapiḥ ॥5-1-191॥

translations.english: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.

verses.sloka: स तस्या विवृते वक्त्रे वज्रसंहननः कपिः ।संक्षिप्य मुहुरात्मानं निष्पपात महाबलः ॥५-१-१९२॥
verses.transliteration: sa tasyā vivṛte vaktre vajrasaṁhananaḥ kapiḥ ।saṁkṣipya muhurātmānaṁ niṣpapāta mahābalaḥ ॥5-1-192॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the vanara whose physique was as hard as thunderbolt suddenly contracted once again and entered her opened mouth.

verses.sloka: आस्ये तस्या निमज्जन्तं ददृशुः सिद्धचारणाः ।ग्रस्यमानं यथा चन्द्रं पूर्णं पर्वणि राहुणा ॥५-१-१९३॥
verses.transliteration: āsye tasyā nimajjantaṁ dadṛśuḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ।grasyamānaṁ yathā candraṁ pūrṇaṁ parvaṇi rāhuṇā ॥5-1-193॥

translations.english: The siddhas and charanas who were watching his performance of drowning in her mouth were amazed as though the moon is seized by Rahu on a fullmoon night.

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्या नखैस्तीक्णैर्मर्माण्युत्कृत्य वानरः ।उत्पपाताथ वेगेन मनः संपातविक्रमः ॥५-१-१९४॥
verses.transliteration: tatastasyā nakhaistīkṇairmarmāṇyutkṛtya vānaraḥ ।utpapātātha vegena manaḥ saṁpātavikramaḥ ॥5-1-194॥

translations.english: The vanara who had the speed of mind tore her vital parts with his sharp nails and rushed out quickly before she closed her mouth.

verses.sloka: तां तु दृष्ट्वा च धऋत्या च दाक्षिण्येन निपात्य च ।स कपिप्रवरो वेगाद्ववृधे पुनरात्मवान् ॥५-१-१९५॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā ca dhaṛtyā ca dākṣiṇyena nipātya ca ।sa kapipravaro vegādvavṛdhe punarātmavān ॥5-1-195॥

translations.english: Selfcontrolled Hanuman, the great monkey acting with firmness of mind and ingenuity threw her down and once again rapidly grew in size.

verses.sloka: हृतहृत्सा हनुमता पपात विधुराम्भसि ।तां हतां वानरेणाशु पतितां वीक्ष्य सिंहिकाम् ॥५-१-१९६॥
verses.transliteration: hṛtahṛtsā hanumatā papāta vidhurāmbhasi ।tāṁ hatāṁ vānareṇāśu patitāṁ vīkṣya siṁhikām ॥5-1-196॥

translations.english: Heart torn asunder and killed by Hanuman, miserable Simhika instantly fell into the sea water. Observing it, the beings who ranged the sky said to the foremost of vanaras:

verses.sloka: भूतान्याकाशचारीणी तमूचुः प्लवगोत्तमम् ।भीममद्य कृतं कर्म महत्सत्त्वं त्वया हतम् ॥५-१-१९७॥
verses.transliteration: bhūtānyākāśacārīṇī tamūcuḥ plavagottamam ।bhīmamadya kṛtaṁ karma mahatsattvaṁ tvayā hatam ॥5-1-197॥

translations.english: "O great jumper a great deed has been done by you today in killing that fierce creature. O great monkey fulfil your mission without any obstruction.

verses.sloka: साधयार्थमभिप्रेतमरिष्टं प्लवतां वर ।यस्य त्वेतानि चत्वारि वानरेन्द्र यथा तव ॥५-१-१९८॥
verses.transliteration: sādhayārthamabhipretamariṣṭaṁ plavatāṁ vara ।yasya tvetāni catvāri vānarendra yathā tava ॥5-1-198॥

translations.english: "O lord of vanaras he in whom these four qualities, fortitude, vision, intelligence and dexterity exist as in you will achieve his mission and not get lost".

verses.sloka: धृतिर्दृष्टिर्मतिर्दाक्ष्यं स कर्मसु न सीदति ।स तैः संभावितः पूज्यः प्रतिपन्नप्रयोजनः ॥५-१-१९९॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛtirdṛṣṭirmatirdākṣyaṁ sa karmasu na sīdati ।sa taiḥ saṁbhāvitaḥ pūjyaḥ pratipannaprayojanaḥ ॥5-1-199॥

translations.english: Honoured by them the venerable monkey went ascending into the sky like Garuda to achieve the objective.

verses.sloka: जगामाकाशमाविश्य पन्नगाशनवत्कपिः ।प्राप्तभूयिष्ठपारस्तु सर्वतः प्रतिलोकयन् ॥५-१-२००॥
verses.transliteration: jagāmākāśamāviśya pannagāśanavatkapiḥ ।prāptabhūyiṣṭhapārastu sarvataḥ pratilokayan ॥5-1-200॥

translations.english: On reaching the other side of the shore crossing a hundred yojanas, he saw rows of forest trees.

verses.sloka: योजनानां शतस्यान्ते वनराजिं ददर्श सः ।ददर्श च पतन्नेव विविधद्रुमभूषितम् ॥५-१-२०१॥
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṁ śatasyānte vanarājiṁ dadarśa saḥ ।dadarśa ca patanneva vividhadrumabhūṣitam ॥5-1-201॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the best among jumpers, even while in air he saw an island adorned with many trees, also gardens adjacent to Malaya mountain.
translations.hindi: “तब उन्हें वहाँ से सौ योजन के फासले पर बड़ा भारी एक जंगल देख पड़ा । जाते जाते उन्होंने विविध वृक्षों से भूषित

verses.sloka: द्वीपं शाखामृगश्रेष्ठो मलयोपवनानि च ।सागरं सागरानूपं सागरानूपजान् द्रुमान् ॥५-१-२०२॥
verses.transliteration: dvīpaṁ śākhāmṛgaśreṣṭho malayopavanāni ca ।sāgaraṁ sāgarānūpaṁ sāgarānūpajān drumān ॥5-1-202॥

translations.english: He surveyed the ocean, its shores, the trees born upon those shores, and the mouths of the ocean's wives as well.

verses.sloka: सागरस्य च पत्नीनां मुखान्यपि विलोकयन् ।स महामेघसंकाशं समीक्ष्यात्मानमात्मवान् ॥५-१-२०३॥
verses.transliteration: sāgarasya ca patnīnāṁ mukhānyapi vilokayan ।sa mahāmeghasaṁkāśaṁ samīkṣyātmānamātmavān ॥5-1-203॥

translations.english: Considering himself, wise and self-possessed, to resemble a great cloud and as though to block the sky, he formed a resolve.
translations.hindi: तथा सागर की पत्ती अर्थात्‌ नदियों को और समुद्र के संगमस्थानों को (भी) देख बुद्धिमात्‌ हनुमानजी ने महामेघ के समान अपने शरीर को जो आकाश को ढके हुए था, देख कर अपने मन में विचारा कि, मेरा यह बड़ा शरीर और मेरा वेग देख कर राक्षस लोग

verses.sloka: निरुन्धन्तमिवाकाशं चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ।कायवृद्धिं प्रवेगं च मम दृष्ट्वव राक्षसाः ॥५-१-२०४॥
verses.transliteration: nirundhantamivākāśaṁ cakāra matimān matim ।kāyavṛddhiṁ pravegaṁ ca mama dṛṣṭvava rākṣasāḥ ॥5-1-204॥

translations.english: "As soon as the rakshasas see the swelling of my body and my speed," thought that great-minded one, "they will grow curious about me."

verses.sloka: मयि कौतूहलं कुर्युरिति मेने महाकपिः ।ततः शरीरं संक्षिप्य तन्महीधरसन्निभम्॥५-१-२०५॥
verses.transliteration: mayi kautūhalaṁ kuryuriti mene mahākapiḥ ।tataḥ śarīraṁ saṁkṣipya tanmahīdharasannibham॥5-1-205॥

translations.english: Then, drawing in that body which resembled a mountain, he resumed his natural form, as a self-possessed man who has been freed of delusion.
translations.hindi: मुझे एक खेल की वस्तु समझेंगे, यह विचार उन्होंने भ्रपने पर्वताकार शरीर को अति छोटा कर लिया । उन्होंने काममोहादिविहीन जीवन्मुक्त योगी की तरह पुनः भ्रपना लघुरूप जो सदा का था, वेसे ही धारण कर लिया; जैसे भगवानु वामन ने बलि को छलने के समय अपने शरीर को बढ़ा कर, पुनः छोटा कर लिया था

verses.sloka: पुनः प्रकृतिमापेदे वीतमोह इवात्मवान् ।तद्रूपमतिसंक्षिप्य हनुमान् प्रकृतौ स्थितः ॥५-१-२०६॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ prakṛtimāpede vītamoha ivātmavān ।tadrūpamatisaṁkṣipya hanumān prakṛtau sthitaḥ ॥5-1-206॥

translations.english: Having wholly contracted that form, Hanuman stood in his natural state, like the tawny god who took away the might of Bali when he had paced his three strides.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी, समुद्र तीरवर्ती त्रिकूटपवंत के शिखर पर बसी हुई लंका ' को देख और भ्रपने पूर्वरूप को त्याग तथा वहाँ के पशुपक्षियों को डराते हुए; लम्ब गिरि नामक पर्वत पर उतरे

verses.sloka: त्रीन् क्रमानिव विक्रम्य बलिवीर्यहरो हरिः ।स चारुनानाविधरूपधारी ।परं समासाद्य समुद्रतीरम् ।परैरशक्यः प्रतिपन्नरूपः ।समीक्षितात्मा समवेक्षितार्थः ॥५-१-२०७॥
verses.transliteration: trīn kramāniva vikramya balivīryaharo hariḥ ।sa cārunānāvidharūpadhārī ।paraṁ samāsādya samudratīram ।parairaśakyaḥ pratipannarūpaḥ ।samīkṣitātmā samavekṣitārthaḥ ॥5-1-207॥

translations.english: Wearing many fair forms at will and unassailable by his foes, having taken form, surveyed himself and weighed his purpose, he reached the further shore of the sea.
translations.hindi: “अविध मनोहर रूप घारण करने वाले हनुमानजी ने दूसरे द्वारा न पार जाने योग्य समुद्र के पार पहुंच कर, और श्रागे के कत्तव्य का भली भाँति विचार कर, थ्पना कार्य सिद्ध करने के लिए अत्यन्त छोटा रूप धारण किग्रा

verses.sloka: ततः स लम्बस्य गिरेः समृद्धे ।विचित्रकूटे निपपात कूटे ।सकेतकोद्दालकनाLइकेरे ।महाभ्रकूटप्रतिमो महात्मा ॥५-१-२०८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa lambasya gireḥ samṛddhe ।vicitrakūṭe nipapāta kūṭe ।saketakoddālakanāLikere ।mahābhrakūṭapratimo mahātmā ॥5-1-208॥

translations.english: Then that great-souled one, like a peak of great cloud, alighted upon a crag of the Lamba mountain, rich and wondrous with its ketaka, uddalaka and coconut trees.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर समुद्रतट से हनुमानजी लम्ब नामक पर्वत के ऊपर गए । उस सम्बपवंत पर केतकी, उद्दालक, नारियल ग्रादि के श्रनेक फले फूले वृक्ष सगे हुए 'थे । उस पवंत के शिखर भी बड़े सुन्दर थे । उन्हीं सुन्दर शिखरों में से एक शिखर पर हनुमानजी जा कर ठहरे

verses.sloka: ततस्तु संप्राप्य समुद्रतीरं ।समीक्ष्य लङ्कां गिरिवर्यमूर्ध्नि ।कपिस्तु तस्मिन्निपपात पर्वते ।विधूय रूपं व्यथयन्म्Rऋगद्विजान् ॥५-१-२०९॥
verses.transliteration: tatastu saṁprāpya samudratīraṁ ।samīkṣya laṅkāṁ girivaryamūrdhni ।kapistu tasminnipapāta parvate ।vidhūya rūpaṁ vyathayanmRṛgadvijān ॥5-1-209॥

translations.english: Then, having reached the sea-shore and beheld Lanka upon the crest of that best of mountains, the monkey shook off his form and alighted on that mountain, startling the beasts and birds.

verses.sloka: स सागरं दानवपन्नगायुतं ।बलेन विक्रम्य महोर्मिमालिनम् ।निपत्य तीरे च महोदधेस्तदा ।ददर्श लङ्काममरावतीमिव ॥५-१-२१०॥
verses.transliteration: sa sāgaraṁ dānavapannagāyutaṁ ।balena vikramya mahormimālinam ।nipatya tīre ca mahodadhestadā ।dadarśa laṅkāmamarāvatīmiva ॥5-1-210॥

translations.english: Having overleapt by his strength the ocean filled with danavas and serpents and garlanded with great waves, he alighted on the shore of the great sea and beheld Lanka, which was like Amaravati.
